main

Hardware Compute Visualizer.

Pick a part of this PC (RAM / CPU / GPU / board / disk) and a test, press Start: a real workload runs in its own process, sensors are polled read-only at 20 Hz, and the diagram + readout follow the real numbers. Every run is recorded to runs/ so it can be compared with the previous one, compared side by side with any other run (for example the same program before and after a change) and replayed. YOUR CODE runs the user's own program and analysis.py points out where it wastes the hardware. AI CONTROL lets another program (an AI) drive the window through control.py while you watch. See SRS_HardwareComputeVisualizer.md.

  54def lighten(hex_color, amount=0.35):
  55    """Lighten a #rrggbb color toward white by amount (0-1)."""
  56    return mix(hex_color, "#ffffff", amount)
  57
  58
  59def mix(c1, c2, t):
  60    """Blend #rrggbb c1 -> c2 by t (0-1)."""
  61    a, b = c1.lstrip("#"), c2.lstrip("#")
  62    out = []
  63    for i in (0, 2, 4):
  64        x, y = int(a[i:i + 2], 16), int(b[i:i + 2], 16)
  65        out.append(int(x + (y - x) * max(0.0, min(1.0, t))))
  66    return "#{:02x}{:02x}{:02x}".format(*out)
  67
  68
  69def chamfer(canvas, x0, y0, x1, y1, c=14, **kwargs):
  70    """Rectangle with two cut corners (top-left, bottom-right), gaming-panel style."""
  71    points = [x0 + c, y0, x1, y0, x1, y1 - c, x1 - c, y1, x0, y1, x0, y0 + c]
  72    return canvas.create_polygon(points, **kwargs)

  78# Neon versions of the SRS colors (CPU blue, GPU green, RAM yellow) + storage magenta, board teal.
  79# Laid out the way data flows: RAM - CPU - GPU (in its PCIe slot) - board/chipset - disk.
  80PARTS = {
  81    "ram": {"label": "RAM", "color": "#ffb400"},
  82    "cpu": {"label": "CPU", "color": "#00a8ff"},
  83    "gpu": {"label": "GPU", "color": "#44d62c"},
  84    "board": {"label": "BOARD", "color": "#1de9b6"},

  88SLOT_MARGIN, SLOT_GAP, SLOT_TOP, SLOT_BOTTOM = 18, 28, 28, 208

  91    _x = SLOT_MARGIN + _i * (_slot_w + SLOT_GAP)
  92    PARTS[_key]["rect"] = (round(_x), SLOT_TOP, round(_x + _slot_w), SLOT_BOTTOM)

 158class Tooltip:
 159    """A small hover note for a widget; `text` may be a function (asked each time it shows)."""
 160
 161    def __init__(self, widget, text, delay=450):
 162        self.widget, self.text, self.delay = widget, text, delay
 163        self.tip = self.job = None
 164        widget.bind("<Enter>", self._schedule, add="+")
 165        widget.bind("<Leave>", self._hide, add="+")
 166        widget.bind("<ButtonPress>", self._hide, add="+")
 167
 168    def _schedule(self, _e=None):
 169        self._hide()
 170        self.job = self.widget.after(self.delay, self._show)
 171
 172    def _show(self):
 173        text = self.text() if callable(self.text) else self.text
 174        if not text:
 175            return
 176        x = self.widget.winfo_rootx() + 12
 177        y = self.widget.winfo_rooty() + self.widget.winfo_height() + 4
 178        self.tip = tk.Toplevel(self.widget)
 179        self.tip.wm_overrideredirect(True)
 180        self.tip.wm_geometry(f"+{x}+{y}")
 181        tk.Label(self.tip, text=text, justify="left", bg="#1d2228", fg="#e6e6e6", font=(FONT, 10),
 182                 relief="solid", bd=1, padx=8, pady=5, wraplength=380).pack()
 183
 184    def _hide(self, _e=None):
 185        if self.job:
 186            self.widget.after_cancel(self.job)
 187            self.job = None
 188        if self.tip:
 189            self.tip.destroy()
 190            self.tip = None
 191

 224class _Dialogs:
 225    """Stands in for tkinter.messagebox. While an AI controls the app nobody may be at the
 226    keyboard to click a pop-up, so notices go to the log (and back to the AI), and a
 227    "continue?" question is answered by the AI's own `confirm` flag on START."""
 228
 229    def __init__(self):
 230        self.app = None
 231        self.confirm = False
 232        self.notes = []  # what the dialogs said during the current AI action
 233
 234    def _ai(self):
 235        return self.app is not None and (self.app.control is not None or self.app.editor_busy)
 236
 237    def _note(self, kind, title, msg):
 238        self.notes.append({"kind": kind, "title": title, "text": msg})
 239        if self.app.editor_busy:
 240            self.app._log(f"💻 [{title}] {msg}", "editor")
 241        else:
 242            self.app._log(f"🤖 [{title}] {msg}", "ai")
 243
 244    def showerror(self, title, msg, **kw):
 245        return self._note("error", title, msg) if self._ai() else _messagebox.showerror(title, msg, **kw)
 246
 247    def showwarning(self, title, msg, **kw):
 248        return self._note("warning", title, msg) if self._ai() else _messagebox.showwarning(title, msg, **kw)
 249
 250    def showinfo(self, title, msg, **kw):
 251        return self._note("info", title, msg) if self._ai() else _messagebox.showinfo(title, msg, **kw)
 252
 253    def askokcancel(self, title, msg, **kw):
 254        if not self._ai():
 255            return _messagebox.askokcancel(title, msg, **kw)
 256        self._note("question", title, msg)
 257        return self.confirm
 258
 259
 260messagebox = _Dialogs()

 263class Replay:
 264    """Stands in for telemetry.Poller while a recorded run is played back:
 265    `latest` is the recorded sample for the current playback time."""
 266
 267    def __init__(self, samples):
 268        self.samples = samples
 269        self.i = 0
 270        self.t0 = time.monotonic()
 271
 272    def start(self):
 273        self.t0 = time.monotonic()
 274
 275    def stop(self):
 276        pass
 277
 278    @property
 279    def latest(self):
 280        elapsed = time.monotonic() - self.t0
 281        while self.i + 1 < len(self.samples) and self.samples[self.i + 1]["t"] <= elapsed:
 282            self.i += 1
 283        return self.samples[self.i]
 284

 286class SearchCombo:
 287    """Type to filter, click a result to pick it. The result list floats over
 288    the layout (child of `overlay`) so it never pushes widgets around."""
 289
 290    def __init__(self, parent, overlay, key, options, color, on_pick):
 291        self.key = key
 292        self.options = options
 293        self.on_pick = on_pick
 294        self.color = color
 295        self.hover_color = lighten(color, 0.35)
 296        self._focused = False
 297        self._no_match = False
 298
 299        self.frame = tk.Frame(parent, bg=BG)
 300        self.var = tk.StringVar()
 301        self.entry = tk.Entry(
 302            self.frame, textvariable=self.var, font=(FONT, 10), width=12,
 303            bg=PANEL, fg=FG, insertbackground=FG, relief="flat",
 304            highlightthickness=2, highlightbackground=color, highlightcolor=color,
 305        )
 306        self.entry.pack(fill="x", ipady=6)
 307        self.listbox = tk.Listbox(
 308            overlay, height=3, font=(FONT, 10), bg=PANEL, fg=FG, relief="flat",
 309            selectbackground=color, activestyle="none", highlightthickness=0, exportselection=False,
 310        )
 311        self.listbox.bind("<<ListboxSelect>>", self._on_select)
 312
 313        self.enabled = bool(options)
 314        if self.enabled:
 315            self.entry.bind("<FocusIn>", self._on_focus_in)
 316            self.entry.bind("<FocusOut>", self._on_focus_out)
 317            self.entry.bind("<KeyRelease>", self._filter)
 318            self.entry.bind("<Enter>", lambda e: self._set_border(self.hover_color))
 319            self.entry.bind("<Leave>", lambda e: None if self._focused else self._set_border(color))
 320            self.clear()
 321        else:
 322            self.var.set("not detected")
 323            self.entry.config(state="disabled", fg=MUTED, disabledforeground=MUTED,
 324                              disabledbackground=PANEL, highlightbackground=GREY)
 325
 326    def _set_border(self, c):
 327        self.entry.config(highlightbackground=c, highlightcolor=c)
 328
 329    def _on_focus_in(self, event=None):
 330        self._focused = True
 331        self._set_border(self.hover_color)
 332        if self._placeholder:
 333            self.entry.delete(0, "end")
 334            self.entry.config(fg=FG)
 335            self._placeholder = False
 336        self._show_results(self.options)
 337
 338    def _on_focus_out(self, event=None):
 339        self._focused = False
 340        self._set_border(self.color)
 341        self.entry.after(150, self._maybe_hide)
 342        if not self.var.get():
 343            self.clear()
 344
 345    def _maybe_hide(self):
 346        if self.entry.focus_get() not in (self.entry, self.listbox):
 347            self._hide_results()
 348
 349    def _filter(self, event=None):
 350        q = self.var.get().strip().lower()
 351        matches = [o for o in self.options if q in o.lower()] if q else self.options
 352        self._show_results(matches)
 353
 354    def _show_results(self, matches):
 355        self._no_match = not matches
 356        self.listbox.delete(0, "end")
 357        for m in (matches or ["No matches"]):
 358            self.listbox.insert("end", m)
 359        self.listbox.config(height=min(3, max(1, len(matches))))
 360        self.listbox.place(in_=self.entry, x=0, rely=1.0, y=2, relwidth=1.0)
 361        self.listbox.lift()
 362
 363    def _hide_results(self):
 364        self.listbox.place_forget()
 365
 366    def _on_select(self, event=None):
 367        sel = self.listbox.curselection()
 368        if not sel or self._no_match:
 369            return
 370        value = self.listbox.get(sel[0])
 371        self.set_value(value)
 372        self._hide_results()
 373        self.entry.master.focus_set()
 374        self.on_pick(self.key, value)
 375
 376    def set_value(self, value):
 377        self._placeholder = False
 378        self.entry.delete(0, "end")
 379        self.entry.insert(0, value)
 380        self.entry.config(fg=FG)
 381
 382    def clear(self):
 383        self.entry.delete(0, "end")
 384        self.entry.insert(0, f"Search {self.key.upper()}...")
 385        self.entry.config(fg=MUTED)
 386        self._placeholder = True
 387        self._hide_results()
 388

 390class App:
 391    def __init__(self, root):
 392        self.root = root
 393        root.title("Hardware Compute Visualizer")
 394        root.configure(bg=BG)
 395        root.minsize(900, 760)
 396        w, h = 940, min(1160, root.winfo_screenheight() - 80)
 397        root.geometry(f"{w}x{h}+{(root.winfo_screenwidth() - w) // 2}+{max(0, (root.winfo_screenheight() - h) // 2 - 20)}")
 398
 399        self.control = None      # control.ControlServer while AI CONTROL is on
 400        self.link = None         # the editor link (VS Code): always on, found through app.json
 401        self.editor_busy = False  # True while an editor request is being done

 667    @staticmethod
 668    def _options_for(hw):
 669        """Search options per part from a detect_hardware() report."""
 670        return {
 671            "ram": [hw["ram"]] if hw.get("ram") else [],
 672            "cpu": [hw["cpu"]] if hw.get("cpu") else [],
 673            "gpu": list(hw.get("gpus") or []),
 674            "board": [hw["board"]] if hw.get("board") else [],
 675            "disk": [d["label"] for d in hw.get("disks") or []],
 676        }
 677
 678    def _build_combos(self):
 679        for i, key in enumerate(ORDER):
 680            c = SearchCombo(self.combo_row, self.outer, key, self.options[key], PARTS[key]["color"],
 681                            self._on_combo)
 682            c.frame.grid(row=0, column=i, padx=6, sticky="new")
 683            self.combos[key] = c
 684
 685    def _machine_name(self):
 686        return self.hw.get("machine") or "?"
 687
 688    def _show_target(self):
 689        self.target_lbl.config(text=f"THIS PC  {self._machine_name()}", fg=FG)
 690
 691    def _apply_hardware(self):
 692        """The target machine changed: rebuild the part list, search boxes and diagram."""
 693        self.options = self._options_for(self.hw)
 694        if self.selected is not None:
 695            self.canvas.itemconfig(self.shapes[self.selected][0], width=2)
 696        self.selected = self.selected_value = None
 697        self.gpu_index = self.disk_index = 0
 698        for c in self.combos.values():
 699            c.listbox.destroy()
 700            c.frame.destroy()
 701        self.combos = {}
 702        self._build_combos()
 703        for key in ORDER:
 704            if self.options[key]:
 705                self._light_up(key)
 706            else:
 707                self._grey_out(key)
 708        self._clear_readout()
 709        self._build_core_strip()
 710        self._show_target()
 711
 712    def _build_core_strip(self):
 713        """One small bar per logical CPU inside the CPU box: a single lit bar among dark
 714        ones is serial code, all lit is parallel code. Many cores share bars (max 64)."""
 715        self.canvas.delete("cores")
 716        n = min(int(self.hw.get("threads") or 0), 64) if self.options["cpu"] else 0
 717        self.core_bars, self.core_lv, self._core_col = [], [0.0] * n, {}
 718        if not n:
 719            return
 720        x0, y0, x1, y1 = PARTS["cpu"]["rect"]
 721        bx0, bx1 = x0 + 16, x1 - 16
 722        self.core_box = (y1 - 58, y1 - 37)  # top, bottom of the bars
 723        top, bot = self.core_box
 724        w = (bx1 - bx0) / n
 725        gap = 1 if w > 3 else 0
 726        for i in range(n):
 727            xa, xb = bx0 + i * w + gap, bx0 + (i + 1) * w - gap
 728            self.canvas.create_rectangle(xa, top, xb, bot, fill="#121a20", outline="", tags=("part_cpu", "cores"))
 729            self.core_bars.append(self.canvas.create_rectangle(xa, bot, xb, bot, fill=PARTS["cpu"]["color"],
 730                                                               outline="", tags=("part_cpu", "cores")))
 731
 732    def _browse_program(self):
 733        path = filedialog.askopenfilename(title="Your program", filetypes=[
 734            ("Programs and scripts", "*.py *.exe *.bat *.cmd"), ("All files", "*.*")])
 735        if path:
 736            self.folder_var.set("")  # the new program's project folder, unless one is typed
 737            self.program_var.set(f'"{os.path.normpath(path)}"')

 740        if not self.running:
 741            CompareWindow(self.root)

 743    # ------------------------------------------------------------ editor link (VS Code)
 744    def _open_link(self):
 745        """The editor link: a token-protected local API on a free port, published in app.json so the
 746        VS Code extension connects by itself. No banners or pauses: you started it from the editor."""
 747        try:
 748            self.link = control.ControlServer(port=0, token_file=None, actions=control.EDITOR_ACTIONS)
 749            control.publish_link(self.link)
 750        except OSError as e:
 751            self.link = None
 752            self._log(f"VS Code link unavailable: {e}", "info")
 753
 754    def _drain_link(self):
 755        while True:
 756            try:
 757                action, args, reply = self.link.requests.get_nowait()
 758            except queue.Empty:
 759                return
 760            if action not in ("state", "summary"):
 761                desc, _ = self._ai_describe(action, args)
 762                self._log(f"💻 VS Code → {desc}", "editor")
 763            messagebox.notes = []
 764            self.editor_busy = True
 765            try:
 766                reply.put(self._ai_do(action, args))
 767            except Exception as e:  # report, never kill the UI loop
 768                reply.put((500, {"error": f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"}))
 769            finally:
 770                self.editor_busy = False
 771
 772    def _open_in_editor(self, file, line):
 773        """A line of the user's code in VS Code (vscode://file/...), else the file itself."""
 774        uri = "vscode://file/" + os.path.abspath(file).replace("\\", "/") + f":{line}"
 775        try:
 776            if sys.platform == "win32":
 777                os.startfile(uri)
 778            else:
 779                subprocess.Popen(["xdg-open" if sys.platform != "darwin" else "open", uri])
 780        except OSError as e:
 781            self._log(f"Can't open {file}:{line} in VS Code: {e}", "blocked")
 782
 783    # ------------------------------------------------------------ AI control (control.py)
 784    def toggle_ai_control(self):
 785        if self.control:
 786            self.control.close()
 787            self.control = None
 788            self.btn_ai.config(text="AI CONTROL: OFF", bg=BG, fg=AI_COLOR)
 789            self.ai_banner.config(text="")
 790            self._log("🤖 AI control is off.", "ai")
 791            return
 792        try:
 793            self.control = control.ControlServer()
 794        except OSError as e:
 795            messagebox.showerror("AI control", f"Can't open 127.0.0.1:{control.PORT}: {e}")
 796            return
 797        self.btn_ai.config(text="AI CONTROL: ON", bg=AI_COLOR, fg="black")
 798        self.ai_banner.config(text="🤖 AI CONTROL ON")
 799        self._log(f"🤖 AI control is on: 127.0.0.1:{control.PORT}, token in control_token.txt. "
 800                  "Everything the AI does shows here in purple.", "ai")
 801
 802    def _flash(self, widget, times=3):
 803        """Blink a widget the AI is 'pressing' so the action is easy to see."""
 804        try:
 805            normal = widget.cget("bg")
 806        except tk.TclError:
 807            return
 808
 809        def step(n):
 810            try:
 811                widget.config(bg=AI_COLOR if n % 2 == 0 else normal)
 812            except tk.TclError:
 813                return
 814            if n < 2 * times - 1:
 815                self.root.after(120, step, n + 1)
 816        step(0)
 817
 818    def _drain_control(self):
 819        """AI requests -> UI thread. 'state' answers at once; every other action is shown
 820        first (banner, log, flashing control) and done a moment later, one at a time."""
 821        while True:
 822            try:
 823                item = self.control.requests.get_nowait()
 824            except queue.Empty:
 825                break
 826            if item[0] in ("state", "summary", "runs"):
 827                action, args, reply = item
 828                reply.put(self._ai_do(action, args))
 829            else:
 830                self._ai_queue.append(item)
 831        if self._ai_busy or not self._ai_queue:
 832            return
 833        action, args, reply = self._ai_queue.popleft()
 834        desc, widget = self._ai_describe(action, args)
 835        self._ai_busy = True
 836        self.ai_banner.config(text=f"🤖 AI: {desc}")
 837        self._log(f"🤖 AI → {desc}", "ai")
 838        if widget is not None:
 839            self._flash(widget)
 840
 841        def run():
 842            try:
 843                reply.put(self._ai_do(action, args))
 844            except Exception as e:  # report, never kill the UI loop
 845                reply.put((500, {"error": f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"}))
 846            finally:
 847                self._ai_busy = False
 848                if self.control:
 849                    self.root.after(2500, lambda: self.control and not self._ai_busy and
 850                                    self.ai_banner.config(text="🤖 AI CONTROL ON"))
 851        self.root.after(450, run)  # long enough to see what is about to happen
 852
 853    def _ai_describe(self, action, args):
 854        tests = {k: t["short"] for k, t in TESTS.items()}
 855        if action == "select":
 856            part = str(args.get("part", "")).lower()
 857            w = self.combos[part].entry if part in self.combos else None
 858            return f"select {part.upper()}" + (f" ({args['name']})" if args.get("name") else ""), w
 859        if action == "test":
 860            key = self._find_test(args.get("test"))
 861            w = self.radios[list(TESTS).index(key)] if key else None
 862            return f"choose test {tests.get(key, args.get('test'))}", w
 863        if action == "program":
 864            return f"program: {args.get('command', '')}", self.program_entry
 865        if action == "ai_task":
 866            return f"AI task: {args.get('task', '')}", self.goal_menu
 867        if action == "start":
 868            return "press START" + (" (and confirm)" if args.get("confirm") else ""), self.btn_start
 869        if action == "stop":
 870            return "press STOP", self.btn_stop
 871        if action == "replay":
 872            return f"replay {args.get('run', '')}", self.btn_replay
 873        if action == "compare":
 874            return "open COMPARE", self.btn_compare
 875        return action, None
 876
 877    @staticmethod
 878    def _find_test(name):
 879        n = str(name or "").strip().lower()
 880        for k, t in TESTS.items():
 881            if n in (k, t["short"].lower(), t["label"].lower()):
 882                return k
 883        return None
 884
 885    def _ai_state(self):
 886        readings = {}
 887        for key, label, unit, part, src in STATS:
 888            text = self.stat_val[key].cget("text")
 889            if text not in ("—", ""):
 890                readings[label] = text
 891        return {
 892            "machine": self.hw.get("machine"),
 893            "parts": self.options, "selected": {"part": self.selected, "name": self.selected_value},
 894            "test": self.test_var.get(), "tests": {k: t["label"] for k, t in TESTS.items()},
 895            "ai_task": self.goal_ids.get(self.goal_var.get()), "ai_tasks": {v: k for k, v in self.goal_ids.items()},
 896            "program": self.program_var.get(), "running": self.running, "replay": bool(self.replay),
 897            "elapsed_s": round(time.monotonic() - self.t_start, 1) if self.running else None,
 898            "status": self.status.cget("text"), "readings": readings,
 899        }
 900
 901    def _ai_do(self, action, args):
 902        """One AI action on the UI thread -> (HTTP code, body)."""
 903        messagebox.notes = []
 904        ok = lambda **kw: (200, dict(kw, status=self.status.cget("text"), messages=messagebox.notes))  # noqa: E731
 905        bad = lambda msg, **kw: (400, dict(kw, error=msg, status=self.status.cget("text"),  # noqa: E731
 906                                           messages=messagebox.notes))
 907        if action == "state":
 908            return 200, self._ai_state()
 909        if action == "summary":
 910            return 200, {"summary": self.summary.get("1.0", "end").strip()}
 911        if action == "runs":
 912            out = []
 913            for n in sorted((n for n in os.listdir(RUNS_DIR) if n.endswith(".json")), reverse=True) \
 914                    if os.path.isdir(RUNS_DIR) else []:
 915                try:
 916                    with open(os.path.join(RUNS_DIR, n), "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
 917                        r = json.load(f)
 918                except (OSError, ValueError):
 919                    continue
 920                out.append({"run": n, "when": r.get("when"), "machine": r.get("machine"),
 921                            "test": r.get("test_label"), "part": r.get("part"), "program": r.get("program"),
 922                            "result": r.get("result"), "duration_s": r.get("duration"),
 923                            "bottlenecks": [f"{100 * f['share']:.0f}% {f['title']}" for f in r.get("findings") or []]})
 924            return 200, {"runs": out}
 925        busy = self.running and action not in ("stop",)
 926        if busy:
 927            return bad("a test is running - stop it or wait for it first")
 928        if action == "select":
 929            part = str(args.get("part", "")).lower()
 930            part = next((k for k in PARTS if part in (k, PARTS[k]["label"].lower())), None)
 931            if not part:
 932                return bad(f"part must be one of {list(PARTS)}")
 933            if not self.options[part]:
 934                return bad(f"{part} is not detected on this machine")
 935            name = str(args.get("name") or "").lower()
 936            value = next((o for o in self.options[part] if name and name in o.lower()), None)
 937            if name and value is None:
 938                return bad(f"no {part} matching {args['name']!r}", choices=self.options[part])
 939            if value:
 940                self.combos[part].set_value(value)
 941                self._select(part, value)
 942            else:
 943                self._on_diagram_click(part)
 944            return ok(selected={"part": self.selected, "name": self.selected_value})
 945        if action == "test":
 946            key = self._find_test(args.get("test"))
 947            if not key:
 948                return bad("unknown test", tests={k: t["short"] for k, t in TESTS.items()})
 949            self.test_var.set(key)
 950            return ok(test=key)
 951        if action == "program":
 952            self.test_var.set("code")
 953            self.program_var.set(str(args.get("command", "")))
 954            return ok(program=self.program_var.get())
 955        if action == "ai_task":
 956            t = str(args.get("task", "")).lower()
 957            hit = next((title for title, gid in self.goal_ids.items() if t in (gid, title.lower())), None)
 958            if not hit:
 959                return bad("unknown AI task", tasks=list(self.goal_ids.values()))
 960            self.test_var.set("ai")
 961            self.goal_var.set(hit)
 962            return ok(ai_task=self.goal_ids[hit])
 963        if action == "start":
 964            messagebox.confirm = bool(args.get("confirm"))
 965            try:
 966                self.start_test()
 967            finally:
 968                messagebox.confirm = False
 969            if self.running:
 970                return ok(running=True)
 971            asked = [n for n in messagebox.notes if n["kind"] == "question"]
 972            if asked and not args.get("confirm"):
 973                return bad("needs confirmation - call start again with confirm=true to go ahead",
 974                           question=asked[-1]["text"])
 975            return bad("the test did not start")
 976        if action == "stop":
 977            if not self.running:
 978                return bad("nothing is running")
 979            self.stop_test("stopped from VS Code" if self.editor_busy else "stopped by AI")
 980            return ok(stopped=True)
 981        if action == "replay":
 982            path = os.path.join(RUNS_DIR, os.path.basename(str(args.get("run", ""))))
 983            if not os.path.isfile(path):
 984                return bad("no such run - see /runs")
 985            self.start_replay(path)
 986            return ok(running=self.running)
 987        if action == "compare":
 988            CompareWindow(self.root, args.get("a"), args.get("b"))
 989            return ok(opened=True)
 990        return bad("unknown action")
 991
 992    # ------------------------------------------------------------ diagram
 993    def _draw_backdrop(self):
 994        c = self.canvas
 995        for x in range(0, CANVAS_W + 1, 22):
 996            c.create_line(x, 0, x, CANVAS_H, fill="#0e0e0e")
 997        for y in range(0, CANVAS_H + 1, 22):
 998            c.create_line(0, y, CANVAS_W, y, fill="#0e0e0e")
 999        c.create_line(0, 1, CANVAS_W, 1, fill=LINE)
1000        c.create_line(0, CANVAS_H - 1, CANVAS_W, CANVAS_H - 1, fill=LINE)
1001
1002    def _trace_points(self, a, b):
1003        """Polyline for the circuit trace joining part a to part b."""
1004        ra, rb = PARTS[a]["rect"], PARTS[b]["rect"]
1005        span = ORDER.index(b) - ORDER.index(a)
1006        if span > 1:  # bus routed under the boxes in between; longer buses run deeper
1007            shift = (span - 2) * 22 - 11
1008            xa, xb = (ra[0] + ra[2]) / 2 - shift, (rb[0] + rb[2]) / 2 + shift
1009            y = ra[3] + 14 + (span - 2) * 18
1010            return [xa, ra[3], xa, y, xa + 8, y + 8, xb - 8, y + 8, xb, y, xb, rb[3]]
1011        y = (ra[1] + ra[3]) / 2
1012        return [ra[2], y - 22, ra[2] + 14, y - 22, ra[2] + 22, y - 30, rb[0] - 22, y - 30,
1013                rb[0] - 14, y - 22, rb[0], y - 22]
1014
1015    def _draw_trace(self, a, b):
1016        pts = self._trace_points(a, b)
1017        # dim static copper underneath, animated dashes on top
1018        self.canvas.create_line(*pts, fill="#161616", width=5)
1019        item = self.canvas.create_line(*pts, fill=GREY, width=2, dash=(8, 6))
1020        for x, y in (pts[0:2], pts[-2:]):
1021            self.canvas.create_rectangle(x - 3, y - 3, x + 3, y + 3, fill=GREY, outline="")
1022        return item
1023
1024    def _draw_part(self, key):
1025        p = PARTS[key]
1026        x0, y0, x1, y1 = p["rect"]
1027        color = p["color"]
1028        tag = f"part_{key}"
1029        # glow halos (outline-only, recolored from live utilization), outermost first
1030        halos = []
1031        for pad in (7, 4):
1032            halos.append(chamfer(self.canvas, x0 - pad, y0 - pad, x1 + pad, y1 + pad, c=14 + pad,
1033                                 fill="", outline=BG, width=1, tags=tag))
1034        rect = chamfer(self.canvas, x0, y0, x1, y1, c=14, fill=PANEL, outline=mix(color, BG, 0.5),
1035                       width=2, tags=tag)
1036        # scanlines + top ticks for texture
1037        for y in range(y0 + 6, y1, 6):
1038            self.canvas.create_line(x0 + 3, y, x1 - 3, y, fill="#131313", tags=tag)
1039        for i in range(10):
1040            x = x0 + 24 + i * 7
1041            self.canvas.create_line(x, y0 + 2, x, y0 + (7 if i % 3 == 0 else 4), fill=mix(color, BG, 0.4), tags=tag)
1042        # corner brackets (bottom-left / top-right)
1043        for (cx, cy, dx, dy) in ((x0, y1, 1, -1), (x1, y0, -1, 1)):
1044            self.canvas.create_line(cx, cy + dy * 14, cx, cy, cx + dx * 14, cy, fill=color, width=2, tags=tag)
1045        text = self.canvas.create_text(x0 + 18, y0 + 28, text=p["label"], anchor="w", fill=color,
1046                                       font=(FONT, 24, "bold"), tags=tag)
1047        # scrolling history graph (behind the big number): guide lines + the trace itself
1048        # the CPU box keeps room under its graph for the per-core bars
1049        gx0, gx1, gy0, gy1 = x0 + 16, x1 - 16, y0 + 56, y1 - (64 if key == "cpu" else 46)
1050        for frac in (0.0, 0.5, 1.0):
1051            gy = gy1 - (gy1 - gy0) * frac
1052            self.canvas.create_line(gx0, gy, gx1, gy, fill="#1c1c1c", dash=(2, 4), tags=tag)
1053        graph = self.canvas.create_line(gx0, gy1, gx1, gy1, fill=mix(color, BG, 0.4), width=2, tags=tag)
1054        self.graph_box[key] = (gx0, gx1, gy0, gy1)
1055        self.history[key] = collections.deque([0.0] * HISTORY, maxlen=HISTORY)
1056        self.graphs[key] = graph
1057        sub = self.canvas.create_text((x0 + x1) / 2, (gy0 + gy1) / 2, text="", fill=FG,
1058                                      font=(FONT, 36, "bold"), tags=tag)
1059        # segmented meter
1060        bx0, bx1, by = x0 + 16, x1 - 16, y1 - 30
1061        seg_w = (bx1 - bx0) / SEGMENTS
1062        segs = [self.canvas.create_rectangle(bx0 + i * seg_w + 1, by, bx0 + (i + 1) * seg_w - 1, by + 9,
1063                                             fill="#1a1a1a", outline="", tags=tag)
1064                for i in range(SEGMENTS)]
1065        self.shapes[key] = (rect, text, sub)
1066        self.bars[key] = segs
1067        self.glows[key] = halos
1068        self.canvas.tag_bind(tag, "<Button-1>", lambda e, k=key: self._on_diagram_click(k))
1069        self.canvas.tag_bind(tag, "<Enter>", lambda e: self.canvas.config(cursor="hand2"))
1070        self.canvas.tag_bind(tag, "<Leave>", lambda e: self.canvas.config(cursor=""))
1071
1072    def _grey_out(self, key):
1073        rect, text, sub = self.shapes[key]
1074        self.canvas.itemconfig(rect, outline=GREY, fill=PANEL, width=2)
1075        self.canvas.itemconfig(sub, text="NOT DETECTED", font=(FONT, 13, "bold"), fill=MUTED)
1076        self.canvas.itemconfig(text, fill=MUTED)
1077        for seg in self.bars[key]:
1078            self.canvas.itemconfig(seg, fill="#1a1a1a")
1079        self._lit[key] = 0
1080        for halo in self.glows[key]:
1081            self.canvas.itemconfig(halo, outline=BG)
1082
1083    def _light_up(self, key):
1084        rect, text, sub = self.shapes[key]
1085        self.canvas.itemconfig(text, fill=PARTS[key]["color"])
1086        self.canvas.itemconfig(sub, text="", font=(FONT, 36, "bold"), fill=FG)

1088    def _on_diagram_click(self, key):
1089        if not self.options[key]:
1090            return
1091        value = self.selected_value if key == self.selected else self.options[key][0]
1092        self.combos[key].set_value(value)
1093        self._select(key, value)
1094
1095    def _on_combo(self, key, value):
1096        self._select(key, value)
1097
1098    def _select(self, key, value):
1099        if key == self.selected and value == self.selected_value:
1100            return  # UC-4 alt: reselect same part, nothing changes
1101        if self.running:
1102            self.stop_test("stopped: selection changed")  # FR-4
1103        if self.selected is not None and self.selected != key:
1104            self.canvas.itemconfig(self.shapes[self.selected][0], width=2)
1105            self.combos[self.selected].clear()
1106        self.selected, self.selected_value = key, value
1107        if key == "gpu":
1108            self.gpu_index = self.options["gpu"].index(value)
1109        elif key == "disk":
1110            self.disk_index = self.options["disk"].index(value)
1111        self.canvas.itemconfig(self.shapes[key][0], width=3)  # colour is set per frame in _animate
1112        self._set_status(f"Selected: {PARTS[key]['label']} — {value}")
1113        self._sync_controls()
1114
1115    def _set_status(self, text, color=FG):
1116        self.status.config(text=text, fg=color)

1118    # ------------------------------------------------------------ run control
1119    def start_test(self):
1120        if self.running:
1121            return
1122        if self.selected is None:
1123            self._fail("Select a component first (click a part or search for it).")
1124            return
1125        test = TESTS[self.test_var.get()]
1126        script = test["targets"].get(self.selected)
1127        if script is None:
1128            ok = ", ".join(PARTS[p]["label"] for p in test["targets"])
1129            self._fail(f"The {test['label']} can't target {PARTS[self.selected]['label']}. "
1130                       f"It works on: {ok}.")
1131            return
1132        gpus = self.hw.get("gpu_info") or []
1133        gpu_sel = self.gpu_index if gpus else None
1134        if self.selected == "board":
1135            # the board's readings are the PCIe link of an NVIDIA GPU: use the chosen GPU if it is one
1136            nv = [i for i, g in enumerate(gpus) if g["kind"] == "nvml"]
1137            if not nv:
1138                self._fail("The board's readings come from the PCIe link of an NVIDIA GPU (NVML), and this "
1139                           "machine has none - there would be nothing to show.")
1140                return
1141            gpu_sel = gpu_sel if gpu_sel in nv else nv[0]
1142        gpu = gpus[gpu_sel] if gpu_sel is not None else None
1143        if script == "mlgpu" and (not gpu or gpu["kind"] != "nvml"):
1144            self._fail("The ML test on a GPU needs an NVIDIA GPU (it trains with CUDA). "
1145                       "Pick an NVIDIA GPU, or run the ML test on the CPU.")
1146            return
1147        # UC-14 alt a: warn before the test when the target's temperature can't be read
1148        if self.selected == "cpu" and not self.hw.get("cpu_temp") \
1149                and time.monotonic() - self._lhm_probed > 30:
1150            self._lhm_probed = time.monotonic()  # LibreHardwareMonitor may have been started after the app
1151            self.hw["cpu_temp"] = telemetry.probe_lhm() is not None
1152        if self.selected == "cpu" and not self.hw.get("cpu_temp"):
1153            why = "on Windows it needs LibreHardwareMonitor running as administrator"
1154            if not messagebox.askokcancel(
1155                    "No CPU temperature",
1156                    f"CPU temperature isn't readable ({why}), so there is no thermal safety abort "
1157                    "for the CPU. Continue?"):
1158                return
1159        if self.selected == "gpu" and gpu and gpu["kind"] == "pdh" and not telemetry.LHM and not \
1160                messagebox.askokcancel(
1161                    "No GPU temperature",
1162                    "This GPU's temperature isn't readable (for AMD / Intel GPUs it needs LibreHardwareMonitor "
1163                    "running as administrator), so there is no thermal safety abort for it. Continue?"):
1164            return
1165
1166        is_ai, is_code = script == "agent", script == "usercode"
1167        command = self.program_var.get().strip() if is_code else None
1168        if is_code and not command:
1169            self._fail("Type the command that starts your program in PROGRAM (or pick a file with …).")
1170            return
1171        cmd = None
1172        if is_ai:
1173            # UC-7 precondition: Ollama up on localhost with a supported model installed
1174            installed = agent.ollama_models()
1175            if installed is None:
1176                self._fail("Ollama isn't running. Start it (open the Ollama app, or run 'ollama serve') "
1177                           "and press Start again.")
1178                return
1179            model = agent.pick_model(installed)
1180            if model is None:
1181                self._fail(f"No supported model is installed. Run:  ollama pull {agent.MODELS[0]}")
1182                return
1183            workdir = os.path.join(AI_DIR, datetime.datetime.now().strftime("run-%Y%m%d-%H%M%S"))
1184            try:
1185                os.makedirs(workdir)
1186            except OSError as e:
1187                self._fail(f"Can't create the agent's working folder: {e}")
1188                return
1189            self.duration = test.get("seconds", TEST_SECONDS)
1190            cmd = [os.path.join(HERE, "agent.py"), workdir, model,
1191                   self.goal_ids[self.goal_var.get()], str(self.duration)]
1192        else:
1193            self.duration = test.get("seconds", TEST_SECONDS)
1194            cmd = [os.path.join(HERE, "workloads.py"), script, str(self.duration)]
1195            if script == "disk":
1196                folder = self._disk_test_folder()
1197                if folder is None:
1198                    self._fail("This disk has no drive letter, so there is nowhere to put the test file.")
1199                    return
1200                cmd.append(folder)
1201            elif is_code:
1202                cmd.append(command)
1203                self._remember_program(command)
1204
1205        self.script = script
1206        self.is_ai, self.is_code = is_ai, is_code
1207        self.program, self.code_exit = command, None
1208        self.test_key = self.test_var.get()
1209        self.target = self.selected
1210        self.target_name = self.selected_value
1211        involved = dict.fromkeys((self.target,) + OBSERVED[script])
1212        self.involved = tuple(p for p in involved if not (is_ai or is_code) or self.options[p])
1213        self.wl, self.wl_time, self.wl_error, self.wl_got_data = {}, 0.0, None, False
1214        self.samples = {}
1215        self.record = []
1216        self.last_t = None
1217        self.peak_gbps = 0.0
1218        self.peak_io = 0.0
1219        self.lost_since = None
1220        self.msg_unavail = set()
1221        self.ai_steps = self.ai_blocked = 0
1222        self._input_hint = False
1223        self.ai_done_text = self.ai_stop_text = None
1224        while not self.events.empty():
1225            self.events.get_nowait()
1226        if is_ai:
1227            self._log("", None, clear=True)
1228            self._log(f"Working folder: {workdir}", "info")
1229        elif is_code:
1230            self._log("", None, clear=True)
1231            self._log(f"Running: {command}", "info")
1232            py, folder, note = self._code_plan(command)
1233            self._log(f"  {note}", "info")
1234        self.sample_times.clear()
1235
1236        disks = self.hw.get("disks") or []
1237        disk = disks[self.disk_index] if disks else None
1238        try:
1239            env = None
1240            if gpu and gpu["kind"] == "nvml" and not (is_ai or is_code):  # the GPU being watched
1241                env = dict(os.environ, CUDA_DEVICE_ORDER="PCI_BUS_ID", CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=str(gpu["index"]))
1242            if is_code:
1243                py, folder, _ = self._code_plan(command)
1244                env = dict(os.environ, HCV_PYTHON=py or "", HCV_CWD=folder or "")
1245            self.proc = subprocess.Popen(
1246                [sys.executable] + cmd, env=env,
1247                stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL, text=True,
1248                creationflags=getattr(subprocess, "CREATE_NO_WINDOW", 0),
1249            )
1250        except OSError as e:
1251            self._fail(f"Workload failed to launch: {e}")
1252            return
1253        threading.Thread(target=self._read_proc, args=(self.proc,), daemon=True).start()
1254
1255        self.poller = telemetry.Poller(gpu, disk)
1256        self.poller.start()
1257        self.running = True
1258        self.t_start = time.monotonic()
1259        self.btn_start.config(state="disabled")
1260        self.btn_stop.config(state="normal")
1261        self._sync_controls()
1262        self._set_summary("")
1263        self._show_target()
1264
1265    def _disk_test_folder(self):
1266        """A writable folder on the selected disk for the I/O test file (None = no drive letter)."""
1267        letters = self.hw["disks"][self.disk_index]["letters"]
1268        tmp = tempfile.gettempdir()
1269        if tmp[:1].upper() in letters:
1270            return tmp  # the system drive's root usually isn't writable without admin
1271        return f"{letters[0]}:\\" if letters else None
1272
1273    # ------------------------------------------------------------ recorded runs
1274    def start_replay(self, path=None):
1275        """Play a recorded run back through the diagram and readout, clearly marked as a replay."""
1276        if self.running:
1277            return
1278        os.makedirs(RUNS_DIR, exist_ok=True)
1279        path = path or filedialog.askopenfilename(title="Replay a recorded run", initialdir=RUNS_DIR,
1280                                                  filetypes=[("Recorded run", "*.json")])
1281        if not path:
1282            return
1283        try:
1284            with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
1285                run = json.load(f)
1286            samples = run["samples"]
1287            if not samples or run["part"] not in PARTS or not all("t" in s for s in samples):
1288                raise ValueError("no samples in it")
1289        except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError) as e:
1290            self._fail(f"Can't replay {os.path.basename(path)}: {e}")
1291            return
1292        self.replay = run
1293        self.script, self.is_ai, self.is_code = run.get("script"), False, False
1294        self.target = run["part"]
1295        self.involved = tuple(p for p in run.get("involved", [run["part"]]) if p in PARTS)
1296        self.duration = samples[-1]["t"]
1297        self.wl, self.last_t, self.peak_gbps, self.peak_io = {}, None, 0.0, 0.0
1298        self.sample_times.clear()
1299        self.proc = None
1300        self.poller = Replay(samples)
1301        self.poller.start()
1302        self.running = True
1303        self.t_start = time.monotonic()
1304        self.btn_start.config(state="disabled")
1305        self.btn_stop.config(state="normal")
1306        self._sync_controls()
1307        self._set_summary(f"REPLAY - recorded {run.get('when', '?')} on {run.get('part_name', '?')}\n"
1308                          + run.get("summary", ""))
1309
1310    def _save_run(self, result, duration, summary, findings):
1311        """Write this run's samples to RUNS_DIR; returns the file name (None if it couldn't be saved)."""
1312        if not self.record:
1313            return None
1314        now = datetime.datetime.now()
1315        name = f"run-{now:%Y%m%d-%H%M%S}-{self.test_key}-{self.target}.json"
1316        run = {"version": 2, "when": f"{now:%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S}", "machine": self._machine_name(),
1317               "test": self.test_key,
1318               "test_label": TESTS[self.test_key]["label"], "script": self.script,
1319               "part": self.target, "part_name": self.target_name, "involved": list(self.involved),
1320               "hardware": self.options, "result": result, "duration": round(duration, 2),
1321               "program": self.program, "threads": self.hw.get("threads"),
1322               # wall clock at t=0 of the samples: lines them up with a profile of the same run
1323               "started_epoch": time.time() - (time.monotonic() - self.t_start),
1324               "averages": {k: sum(v) / len(v) for k, v in self.samples.items() if v},
1325               "findings": findings, "summary": summary, "samples": self.record}
1326        try:
1327            os.makedirs(RUNS_DIR, exist_ok=True)
1328            with open(os.path.join(RUNS_DIR, name), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
1329                json.dump(run, f)
1330        except OSError:
1331            return None
1332        self._link_profile(run, name)
1333        return name
1334
1335    def _link_profile(self, run, name):
1336        """YOUR CODE that ran the line profiler (VS Code: Profile in the Hardware Visualizer): this
1337        recording and its bottlenecks go into the profile too, so the editor shows them per line."""
1338        import profiler
1339        out = profiler.profile_of_command(self.program) if self.test_key == "code" else None
1340        if not out or not os.path.isfile(out):
1341            return
1342        try:
1343            if profiler.link_visualizer_run(out, run, name):
1344                self._log(f"Linked this recording to the code profile {out}", "info")
1345                self._code_links = _code_lines(out)
1346        except Exception as e:  # the run itself is saved either way
1347            self._log(f"Couldn't link the recording to {out}: {e}", "blocked")
1348
1349    def _previous_run(self):
1350        """Newest saved run of the same test on the same part and hardware, or None."""
1351        try:
1352            names = sorted((n for n in os.listdir(RUNS_DIR)
1353                            if n.endswith(f"-{self.test_key}-{self.target}.json")), reverse=True)
1354        except OSError:
1355            return None
1356        for n in names:
1357            try:
1358                with open(os.path.join(RUNS_DIR, n), "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
1359                    run = json.load(f)
1360            except (OSError, ValueError):
1361                continue
1362            machine = run.get("machine", self.local_hw.get("machine"))  # v1 runs were all on this PC
1363            if (run.get("part_name") == self.target_name and machine == self._machine_name()
1364                    and run.get("program") == self.program and run.get("averages")):
1365                return run
1366        return None
1367
1368    def _sync_controls(self):
1369        """Radios lock while a test runs; the AI task menu is live only for an idle AI selection."""
1370        running = getattr(self, "running", False)
1371        for b in (self.btn_replay, self.btn_compare):
1372            b.config(state="disabled" if running else "normal")
1373        for k, r in zip(TESTS, self.radios):
1374            r.config(state="disabled" if running or not self._test_fits(k) else "normal")
1375        test = self.test_var.get()
1376        if not running and not self._test_fits(test):  # the part changed: pick a test that fits it
1377            fit = next((k for k in TESTS if self._test_fits(k)), None)
1378            if fit and fit != test:
1379                self.test_var.set(fit)  # calls back here
1380                return
1381        for row in (self.goalrow, self.coderow, self.hintrow):
1382            row.pack_forget()
1383        if test == "ai":
1384            self.goalrow.pack(side="left")
1385        elif test == "code":
1386            self.coderow.pack(side="left")
1387        else:
1388            self.hintrow.config(text=f"{TESTS[test]['label']} - {TEST_SECONDS} s on the selected part")
1389            self.hintrow.pack(side="left")
1390        self.goal_menu.config(state="disabled" if running else "normal")
1391        self.program_entry.config(state="disabled" if running else "normal")
1392        self.btn_browse.config(state="disabled" if running else "normal")
1393        for w in (self.folder_entry, self.btn_folder, self.btn_recent):
1394            w.config(state="disabled" if running else "normal")
1395        self.plan_label.pack_forget()
1396        if test == "code":
1397            self.plan_label.pack(side="left")
1398            self._show_plan()
1399        self._update_steps()
1400
1401    def _log(self, text, tag, clear=False):
1402        self.log.config(state="normal")
1403        if clear:
1404            self.log.delete("1.0", "end")
1405        if text:
1406            self.log.insert("end", text + "\n", tag)
1407            self.log.see("end")
1408        self.log.config(state="disabled")
1409
1410    def _drain_events(self):
1411        """Agent events -> log (UI thread only)."""
1412        while True:
1413            try:
1414                d = self.events.get_nowait()
1415            except queue.Empty:
1416                return
1417            ev, text = d.get("ev"), str(d.get("text", ""))
1418            if ev == "tool":
1419                self.ai_steps += 1
1420                self._log(f"▶ {text}", "tool")
1421            elif ev == "blocked":
1422                self.ai_blocked += 1
1423                self._log(f"⛔ BLOCKED: {text}", "blocked")
1424            elif ev == "done":
1425                self.ai_done_text = text
1426                self._log(f"✔ {text}", "done")
1427            elif ev == "timeout":
1428                self._log(f"⏱ {text}", "blocked")
1429            elif ev == "stopped":  # quit without calling finish: not a completed task
1430                self.ai_stop_text = text
1431                self._log(f"■ {text}", "blocked")
1432            elif ev == "result":
1433                self._log("  " + text.replace("\n", "\n  "), "result")
1434            elif ev == "out":
1435                self._log(text, "say")
1436                if "EOFError" in text and not self._input_hint:
1437                    self._input_hint = True
1438                    self._log("■ Your program asked for keyboard input (input()), which the visualizer can't type. "
1439                              "Give it the input as arguments or a file - or run it from VS Code's yellow ▶ "
1440                              "(it runs in a terminal there, where input() works).", "blocked")
1441            elif ev == "exit":
1442                self.code_exit = text
1443                self._log(f"■ {text}", "done")
1444            else:
1445                self._log(text, "say")
1446
1447    def _read_proc(self, proc):
1448        for line in proc.stdout:
1449            try:
1450                d = json.loads(line)
1451            except ValueError:
1452                continue
1453            if "ev" in d:
1454                self.events.put(d)
1455            elif "error" in d:
1456                self.wl_error = d["error"]
1457            else:
1458                self.wl = d
1459                self.wl_time = time.monotonic()
1460                self.wl_got_data = True
1461
1462    def _kill_tree(self):
1463        """Stop the workload; returns True if it had to be force-terminated (FR-10)."""
1464        p = self.proc
1465        if p is None:
1466            return False
1467        try:
1468            parent = psutil.Process(p.pid)
1469            procs = parent.children(recursive=True) + [parent]
1470        except psutil.Error:
1471            return False
1472        for q in procs:
1473            try:
1474                q.terminate()
1475            except psutil.Error:
1476                pass
1477        _, alive = psutil.wait_procs(procs, timeout=2)
1478        for q in alive:
1479            try:
1480                q.kill()
1481            except psutil.Error:
1482                pass
1483        return bool(alive)
1484
1485    def stop_test(self, result, summary=True):
1486        if not self.running:
1487            return
1488        self.running = False
1489        forced = self._kill_tree()
1490        if forced:
1491            result += " (force-stopped)"
1492        self.proc = None
1493        if self.poller:
1494            self.poller.stop()
1495        duration = time.monotonic() - self.t_start
1496        self.btn_start.config(state="normal")
1497        self.btn_stop.config(state="disabled")
1498        self._sync_controls()
1499        self._show_target()
1500        self._drain_events()
1501        if self.replay:
1502            self.replay = None
1503            self._set_status(f"Replay ended: {result}", REPLAY_COLOR)
1504        elif summary:
1505            self._show_summary(result, duration)
1506            self._set_status(f"Test ended: {result}")
1507        self._clear_readout()
1508
1509    def _fail(self, msg):
1510        """UC-13: nothing is shown as running, no telemetry left on screen."""
1511        messagebox.showerror("Can't start test", msg)
1512        self._set_status(msg, "#f87171")
1513
1514    def _on_close(self):
1515        if self.idle:
1516            self.idle.stop()
1517            self.idle = None
1518        if self.control:
1519            self.control.close()
1520            self.control = None
1521        if self.link:
1522            control.unpublish_link()
1523            self.link.close()
1524            self.link = None
1525        self.stop_test("closed", summary=False)
1526        self.root.destroy()
1527
1528    # ------------------------------------------------------------ per-frame loop
1529    def tick(self):
1530        now = time.monotonic()
1531        raw_dt = now - self.last_tick
1532        dt = min(0.1, raw_dt)
1533        self.last_tick = now
1534        if raw_dt > 0:
1535            self.fps += (1.0 / raw_dt - self.fps) * 0.05
1536        try:
1537            if self.link:
1538                self._drain_link()
1539            if self.control:
1540                self._drain_control()
1541            self._idle_sync()
1542            if self.running:
1543                self._tick_running(now)
1544            elif self.idle:
1545                self._tick_idle(now)
1546            self._animate(dt)
1547            if self.running and self.replay:
1548                self.clock.config(text=f"▶ REPLAY (recorded)  {now - self.t_start:4.1f}s", fg=REPLAY_COLOR)
1549            elif self.running:
1550                blink = int((now - self.t_start) * 2) % 2 == 0
1551                while self.sample_times and now - self.sample_times[0] > 1.0:
1552                    self.sample_times.popleft()
1553                # FR-12 / NFR-1 shown live: drawing rate and sensor samples per second
1554                self.clock.config(text=f"{'●' if blink else '○'} LIVE  {now - self.t_start:5.1f}s   "
1555                                       f"{self.fps:3.0f} FPS · {len(self.sample_times):2d} Hz", fg="#ff3b3b")
1556            else:
1557                self.clock.config(text="IDLE · LIVE READINGS" if self.idle_sample else "IDLE", fg=MUTED)
1558        except Exception as e:  # never let the loop die (FR-17)
1559            self._set_status(f"Internal error: {e}", "#f87171")
1560        # aim at the next 1/60 s boundary (a fixed 16 ms wait drifts below 60 FPS on Windows)
1561        self.root.after(max(1, int(1000 * (1 / 60 - (time.monotonic() - now)))), self.tick)
1562
1563    def _wl_fresh(self, now):
1564        return self.wl_got_data and now - self.wl_time <= STALE_S
1565
1566    def _tick_running(self, now):
1567        elapsed = now - self.t_start
1568        if self.replay:
1569            self._tick_replay(elapsed)
1570            return
1571        p = self.proc
1572        self._drain_events()
1573        if self.is_ai and elapsed >= self.duration:
1574            self.stop_test("time limit reached")  # UC-7 alt b
1575            return
1576        if self.is_code and elapsed >= self.duration + 5:  # the runner stops it at the limit itself
1577            self.stop_test("time limit reached")
1578            return
1579        if p.poll() is not None:
1580            # process ended on its own: failure to start (UC-13) or completion (UC-9)
1581            time.sleep(0.05)  # let the reader thread drain the last lines
1582            self._drain_events()
1583            label = TESTS[self.test_key]["label"]
1584            if self.is_ai:
1585                if self.wl_error and not self.ai_steps:
1586                    self.stop_test("failed", summary=False)
1587                    self._fail(f"{label} failed to start: {self.wl_error}")
1588                elif self.wl_error:
1589                    self.stop_test(f"failed — {self.wl_error}")
1590                elif self.ai_done_text is None:
1591                    self.stop_test("time limit reached" if elapsed >= self.duration - 2 else
1592                                   f"agent stopped without finishing ({self.ai_stop_text or 'no reason given'})")
1593                else:
1594                    self.stop_test("completed")
1595            elif not self.wl_got_data:
1596                err = self.wl_error or f"workload exited with code {p.returncode}"
1597                self.stop_test("failed", summary=False)
1598                self._fail(f"{label} failed to start: {err}")
1599            elif self.wl_error:
1600                self.stop_test(f"failed — {self.wl_error}")
1601            elif self.is_code:
1602                self.stop_test(self.code_exit or "program ended")
1603            else:
1604                self.stop_test("completed")
1605            return
1606
1607        if self.is_code:
1608            self._set_status(f"Running your program — {elapsed:.0f} s (stops at {self.duration:.0f} s)")
1609        else:
1610            self._set_status(f"Running {TESTS[self.test_key]['label']} on "
1611                             f"{PARTS[self.target]['label']} — {elapsed:.0f}/{self.duration:.0f} s")
1612
1613        s = self.poller.latest
1614        if not s or s["t"] == self.last_t:
1615            return
1616        self.last_t = s["t"]
1617        self.sample_times.append(now)
1618
1619        merged = dict(s)
1620        fresh = self._wl_fresh(now)
1621        if fresh:
1622            merged.update(self.wl)
1623            if "gbps" in self.wl:
1624                self.peak_gbps = max(self.peak_gbps, self.wl["gbps"])
1625        row = {"t": round(elapsed, 3)}
1626        for k, v in merged.items():
1627            if v is not None and k != "t":
1628                if isinstance(v, (int, float)):
1629                    self.samples.setdefault(k, []).append(v)
1630                row[k] = round(v, 4) if isinstance(v, float) else v
1631        self.record.append(row)
1632
1633        self._update_readout(merged, fresh)
1634        self._check_thermal(merged)
1635
1636    def _tick_replay(self, elapsed):
1637        """One frame of a replay: show the recorded sample for this moment. Nothing is measured,
1638        recorded or safety-checked - the clock and status line say it is a recording."""
1639        run = self.replay
1640        if elapsed >= self.duration + 0.3:
1641            self.stop_test("finished")
1642            return
1643        self._set_status(f"REPLAY (recorded {run.get('when', '?')}, not live) — "
1644                         f"{run.get('test_label', '?')} on {PARTS[self.target]['label']} — "
1645                         f"{min(elapsed, self.duration):.0f}/{self.duration:.0f} s", REPLAY_COLOR)
1646        s = self.poller.latest
1647        if s["t"] == self.last_t:
1648            return
1649        self.last_t = s["t"]
1650        self.sample_times.append(time.monotonic())
1651        self.wl = {k: s[k] for k in WL_KEYS if k in s}
1652        self.peak_gbps = max(self.peak_gbps, s.get("gbps") or 0.0)
1653        self._update_readout(s, True)
1654
1655    def _src(self, key, default):
1656        """Where a metric comes from on the current target (the poller may name another source)."""
1657        p = self.poller if self.running else self.idle
1658        src = (getattr(p, "sources", None) or {}).get(key, default)
1659        if key in ("cpu_temp", "board_temp") and telemetry.LHM and src == default:
1660            src = "LibreHardwareMonitor"
1661        link = (getattr(p, "info", None) or {}).get("pcie_link")
1662        if key == "board_util" and link and src == default:
1663            src = f"{src} · {link}"
1664        return src
1665
1666    def _update_readout(self, m, wl_fresh):
1667        unavail = set()
1668        for key, label, unit, part, src in STATS:
1669            src = self._src(key, src)
1670            v = m.get(key)
1671            relevant = part == "wl" or part in self.involved
1672            if not relevant:
1673                self.stat_val[key].config(text="—", fg=MUTED)
1674                self._set_src(key, src, MUTED)
1675            elif v is None and part == "wl":
1676                self.stat_val[key].config(text="—", fg=MUTED)
1677                self._set_src(key, "not in this test", MUTED)
1678            elif v is None:
1679                self.stat_val[key].config(text="unavailable", fg="#f87171")
1680                self._show_missing(key, src)
1681                if part in PARTS:
1682                    unavail.add(key)
1683            else:
1684                self.stat_val[key].config(text=f"{FMT.get(key, '{:.2f}').format(v)} {unit}", fg=FG)
1685                self._set_src(key, src, MUTED)
1686        # UC-12: if every metric of the target part fails for a second, the run can't be shown
1687        # truthfully (a second, because some readings need a moment to produce their first value)
1688        target_keys = [k for k, _, _, pt, _ in STATS if pt == self.target and k not in OPTIONAL]
1689        if not self.replay and target_keys and all(m.get(k) is None for k in target_keys):
1690            now = time.monotonic()
1691            self.lost_since = self.lost_since or now
1692            if now - self.lost_since >= 1.0:
1693                self.stop_test(f"stopped — {PARTS[self.target]['label']} telemetry lost")
1694                return
1695        else:
1696            self.lost_since = None
1697        self.msg_unavail = unavail
1698
1699    def _check_thermal(self, m):
1700        checks = [("cpu", m.get("cpu_temp"), THERMAL_LIMIT["cpu"]),
1701                  ("gpu", m.get("gpu_temp"), min(THERMAL_LIMIT["gpu"], m.get("gpu_slowdown") or 999))]
1702        for part, temp, limit in checks:
1703            if part in self.involved and temp is not None and temp >= limit:
1704                name = PARTS[part]["label"]
1705                self.stop_test(f"aborted — thermal limit ({name} {temp:.0f} °C)")
1706                messagebox.showwarning("Thermal limit",
1707                                       f"{name} reached {temp:.0f} °C (limit {limit:.0f} °C). Test stopped.")
1708                return
1709
1710    def _target_levels(self):
1711        """Latest real utilization 0..1 per part (None = unavailable)."""
1712        idle = not self.running and self.idle_sample is not None
1713        s = self.idle_sample if idle else (self.poller.latest if self.poller else {})
1714        out = {}
1715        for part in ORDER:
1716            if idle:  # live readings while no test runs: every part, as it is
1717                v = s.get(f"{part}_util")
1718                out[part] = 0.0 if v is None else v / 100.0
1719                continue
1720            if not self.running or part not in self.involved:
1721                out[part] = 0.0
1722                continue
1723            if part == "ram" and self.script == "ram" and self.peak_gbps > 0 and "gbps" in self.wl:
1724                out[part] = min(1.0, self.wl["gbps"] / self.peak_gbps)
1725                continue
1726            v = s.get(f"{part}_util")
1727            if part == "disk" and v is None and s.get("disk_read") is not None:
1728                # no active-time counter: fall back to throughput relative to this run's peak
1729                mb = s["disk_read"] + (s.get("disk_write") or 0.0)
1730                self.peak_io = max(self.peak_io, mb, 200.0)
1731                v = 100.0 * mb / self.peak_io
1732            out[part] = None if v is None else v / 100.0
1733        return out
1734
1735    def _animate(self, dt):
1736        targets = self._target_levels()
1737        self.frame_n += 1
1738        for key in ORDER:
1739            tgt = targets[key]
1740            if tgt is None:  # unavailable: stops animating
1741                tgt = 0.0
1742            # ease toward the latest real sample (never overshoots it)
1743            self.level[key] += (tgt - self.level[key]) * min(1.0, dt * 12)
1744            lv = self.level[key]
1745            if not self.options[key]:
1746                continue
1747            base = PARTS[key]["color"]
1748            rect, text, sub = self.shapes[key]
1749            # panel body warms with load; edge goes white when this part is selected
1750            self.canvas.itemconfig(rect, fill=mix(PANEL, base, lv * 0.22))
1751            edge = mix(mix(base, BG, 0.5), base, lv)
1752            self.canvas.itemconfig(rect, outline=lighten(base, 0.7) if key == self.selected else edge)
1753            outer_halo, inner_halo = self.glows[key]
1754            glow_on = lv > 0.03
1755            self.canvas.itemconfig(outer_halo, outline=mix(BG, base, lv * 0.30) if glow_on else BG)
1756            self.canvas.itemconfig(inner_halo, outline=mix(BG, base, lv * 0.65) if glow_on else BG)
1757            # segmented meter
1758            lit = round(lv * SEGMENTS)
1759            if lit != self._lit.get(key):
1760                self._lit[key] = lit
1761                for i, seg in enumerate(self.bars[key]):
1762                    c = (mix(mix(base, BG, 0.3), lighten(base, 0.4), i / SEGMENTS)) if i < lit else "#1a1a1a"
1763                    self.canvas.itemconfig(seg, fill=c)
1764            show = self.running and key in self.involved
1765            if not self.running and self.idle_sample is not None and self.idle_sample.get(f"{key}_util") is not None:
1766                # idle: the live value, quieter than during a test
1767                self.canvas.itemconfig(sub, text=f"{lv * 100:.0f}%", fill=mix(base, BG, 0.35), font=(FONT, 26, "bold"))
1768            elif show and targets[key] is not None:
1769                self.canvas.itemconfig(sub, text=f"{lv * 100:.0f}%", fill=lighten(base, 0.5), font=(FONT, 36, "bold"))
1770            elif show:
1771                self.canvas.itemconfig(sub, text="UNAVAILABLE", fill="#ff5c5c", font=(FONT, 13, "bold"))
1772            else:
1773                self.canvas.itemconfig(sub, text="")
1774            # history graph: one point per 3 frames, scrolls left; bounded by the eased real samples
1775            hist = self.history[key]
1776            if self.frame_n % 3 == 0:
1777                hist.append(lv)
1778                gx0, gx1, gy0, gy1 = self.graph_box[key]
1779                step = (gx1 - gx0) / (HISTORY - 1)
1780                pts = []
1781                for i, v in enumerate(hist):
1782                    pts += [gx0 + i * step, gy1 - (gy1 - gy0) * v]
1783                self.canvas.coords(self.graphs[key], *pts)
1784                self.canvas.itemconfig(self.graphs[key], fill=mix(mix(base, BG, 0.5), base, 0.4 + 0.6 * lv))
1785        # per-core strip: eased toward each core's latest real reading
1786        cores = None
1787        if self.running and "cpu" in self.involved and self.poller:
1788            c = (self.poller.latest or {}).get("cpu_cores")
1789            cores = c if isinstance(c, list) and c else None
1790        elif not self.running and self.idle_sample:
1791            c = self.idle_sample.get("cpu_cores")
1792            cores = c if isinstance(c, list) and c else None
1793        n = len(self.core_bars)
1794        lit = lighten(PARTS["cpu"]["color"], 0.3)
1795        for i in range(n):
1796            if cores:
1797                a, b = i * len(cores) // n, (i + 1) * len(cores) // n
1798                tgt = max(cores[a:b] or [cores[min(a, len(cores) - 1)]]) / 100.0
1799            else:
1800                tgt = 0.0
1801            self.core_lv[i] += (tgt - self.core_lv[i]) * min(1.0, dt * 12)
1802            top, bot = self.core_box
1803            h = round((bot - top) * self.core_lv[i])
1804            if h != self._core_col.get(i):  # bar height = that core's load
1805                self._core_col[i] = h
1806                xa, _, xb, _ = self.canvas.coords(self.core_bars[i])
1807                self.canvas.coords(self.core_bars[i], xa, bot - h, xb, bot)
1808                self.canvas.itemconfig(self.core_bars[i], fill=mix(PARTS["cpu"]["color"], lit, self.core_lv[i]))
1809        for (a, b), item in self.links.items():
1810            flow = (self.level[a] + self.level[b]) / 2
1811            if (self.running or self.idle_sample is not None) and flow > 0.02:
1812                self.dash_off[(a, b)] -= dt * ((20 + 160 * flow) if self.running else (10 + 60 * flow))
1813                trace = mix(PARTS[a]["color"], PARTS[b]["color"], 0.5)
1814                self.canvas.itemconfig(item, dashoffset=int(self.dash_off[(a, b)]),
1815                                       fill=mix(GREY, lighten(trace, 0.3), flow))
1816            else:
1817                self.canvas.itemconfig(item, fill=GREY)
1818
1819    # ------------------------------------------------------------ readout / summary
1820    def _clear_readout(self):
1821        for key, _, _, _, src in STATS:
1822            if key in ("cpu_temp", "board_temp") and telemetry.LHM:
1823                src = "LibreHardwareMonitor"  # running: the readings come from it during a test
1824            self.stat_val[key].config(text="—", fg=MUTED)
1825            self._set_src(key, src, MUTED)

1827    # ------------------------------------------------------------ live readings while idle
1828    def _idle_sync(self):
1829        """Keeps a slow poller running while no test runs on this PC, so the readings and the
1830        diagram are live; remade when the chosen GPU / disk changes or LHM appears."""
1831        want = not self.running
1832        key = (self.gpu_index, self.disk_index, telemetry.LHM)
1833        if self.idle and (not want or key != self.idle_key):
1834            self.idle.stop()
1835            self.idle, self.idle_sample = None, None
1836            if not want:
1837                self._clear_readout()
1838        if want and not self.idle:
1839            gpus, disks = self.hw.get("gpu_info") or [], self.hw.get("disks") or []
1840            gpu = gpus[self.gpu_index] if gpus and self.gpu_index < len(gpus) else None
1841            disk = disks[self.disk_index] if disks and self.disk_index < len(disks) else None
1842            try:
1843                self.idle = telemetry.Poller(gpu, disk, hz=4)
1844                self.idle.start()
1845                self.idle_key = key
1846            except Exception as e:  # never stop the app over the extra readings
1847                self.idle = None
1848                self._log(f"Live readings unavailable: {e}", "info")
1849
1850    def _tick_idle(self, now):
1851        s = self.idle.latest
1852        if s and s is not self.idle_sample:
1853            self.idle_sample = s
1854            for key, label, unit, part, src in STATS:
1855                src = self._src(key, src)
1856                v = s.get(key)
1857                if part == "wl":
1858                    self.stat_val[key].config(text="—", fg=MUTED)
1859                    self._set_src(key, "shown during its test", MUTED)
1860                elif v is None:
1861                    self.stat_val[key].config(text="—", fg=MUTED)
1862                    self._show_missing(key, src)
1863                else:
1864                    self.stat_val[key].config(text=f"{FMT.get(key, '{:.2f}').format(v)} {unit}", fg=MUTED)
1865                    self._set_src(key, src, MUTED)
1866        if self._lhm_found:
1867            self._lhm_found = False
1868            self._log("LibreHardwareMonitor found: CPU and chipset temperatures are readable now.", "done")
1869        # after "SET UP" for LibreHardwareMonitor: look for it now and then
1870        if now < self._lhm_watch and now >= self._lhm_next:
1871            self._lhm_next = now + 5
1872            threading.Thread(target=self._probe_lhm_bg, daemon=True).start()
1873
1874    def _probe_lhm_bg(self):
1875        """Runs on a thread: only sets flags (Tk may only be touched from the UI thread)."""
1876        if telemetry.probe_lhm():
1877            self._lhm_watch = 0.0
1878            self.hw["cpu_temp"] = True
1879            self._lhm_found = True

1881    # ------------------------------------------------------------ why a reading is missing, and the fix
1882    def _set_src(self, key, text, color, fix=None):
1883        self.stat_fix[key] = fix
1884        self.stat_src[key].config(text=text, fg=color, cursor="hand2" if fix else "")
1885
1886    def _why_missing(self, key, src):
1887        """(reason, fix or None) for a reading that has no value."""
1888        nvml_ok = telemetry.nvgpu.OK
1889        gpus = self.hw.get("gpu_info") or []
1890        has_nv = any(g.get("kind") == "nvml" for g in gpus)
1891        names = " ".join(str(g.get("name", "")) for g in gpus).lower()
1892        if key in ("cpu_temp", "board_temp"):
1893            if not telemetry.LHM:
1894                return ("needs LibreHardwareMonitor · SET UP ›", "lhm")
1895            return ("board has no named sensor" if key == "board_temp" else "LHM has no reading", None)
1896        if key in ("board_util", "pcie_rx", "pcie_tx"):
1897            if not nvml_ok and "nvidia" in names:
1898                return ("needs the nvidia-ml-py package · INSTALL ›", "pip:nvidia-ml-py")
1899            if not has_nv:
1900                return ("needs an NVIDIA graphics card (NVML)", None)
1901        if key.startswith("gpu_"):
1902            if not gpus:
1903                return ("no graphics card found", None)
1904            if not nvml_ok and "nvidia" in names:
1905                return ("needs the nvidia-ml-py package · INSTALL ›", "pip:nvidia-ml-py")
1906            if not has_nv and key in ("gpu_temp", "gpu_power") and not telemetry.LHM:
1907                return ("needs LibreHardwareMonitor for this GPU · SET UP ›", "lhm")
1908        if key == "cpu_power":
1909            return ("Windows doesn't report it for this processor", None)
1910        if key == "disk_util":
1911            return ("Windows' disk counter isn't available", None)
1912        if key == "cpu_freq":
1913            return ("not reported on this PC", None)
1914        return (src, None)
1915
1916    def _show_missing(self, key, src):
1917        reason, fix = self._why_missing(key, src)
1918        self._set_src(key, reason, "#f0b429" if fix else "#f87171", fix)
1919
1920    def _run_fix(self, fix):
1921        if not fix:
1922            return
1923        if fix == "lhm":
1924            script = os.path.join(HERE, "setup_lhm.ps1")
1925            if not messagebox.askokcancel(
1926                    "Set up LibreHardwareMonitor",
1927                    "Windows only gives out CPU and chipset temperatures (and AMD / Intel GPU temperatures) through "
1928                    "LibreHardwareMonitor running as administrator.\n\nThis downloads LibreHardwareMonitor 0.9.6 "
1929                    "(checked against its known hash), starts it hidden in the tray at every logon and keeps its "
1930                    "port closed to other machines. Windows asks once for admin rights.\n\nGo ahead?"):
1931                return
1932            try:
1933                subprocess.Popen(["powershell", "-ExecutionPolicy", "Bypass", "-File", script],
1934                                 creationflags=getattr(subprocess, "CREATE_NEW_CONSOLE", 0))
1935            except OSError as e:
1936                messagebox.showerror("Set up LibreHardwareMonitor", f"Couldn't start the setup: {e}")
1937                return
1938            self._lhm_watch = time.monotonic() + 180  # look for it for 3 minutes
1939            self._log("Setting up LibreHardwareMonitor in a separate window - the temperatures appear here "
1940                      "once it runs.", "info")
1941        elif fix.startswith("pip:"):
1942            pkg = fix[4:]
1943            if not messagebox.askokcancel("Install " + pkg, f"Install the Python package {pkg} into this Python "
1944                                          f"({sys.executable})?\n\nRestart the app when it has finished."):
1945                return
1946            try:
1947                subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, "-m", "pip", "install", pkg],
1948                                 creationflags=getattr(subprocess, "CREATE_NEW_CONSOLE", 0))
1949            except OSError as e:
1950                messagebox.showerror("Install " + pkg, f"Couldn't start pip: {e}")
1951                return
1952            self._log(f"Installing {pkg} in a separate window - restart the app when it's done.", "info")
1953

1962        what = {"2d": "Draws Mandelbrot frames on every CPU core, or copies big blocks of memory (RAM).",
1963                "3d": "Renders a 3D scene with OpenGL and measures the frame time.",

1974    def _update_steps(self):
1975        running = getattr(self, "running", False)
1976        part = PARTS[self.selected]["label"] if self.selected else None
1977        test = TESTS[self.test_var.get()]["short"]
1978        need_prog = self.test_var.get() == "code" and not self.program_var.get().strip()
1979        texts = [f"① PART: {part} ✓" if part else "① CLICK A PART",
1980                 f"② TEST: {test}" + (" - pick your program below" if need_prog else (" ✓" if part else "")),
1981                 "③ RUNNING…" if running else "③ PRESS START"]
1982        states = [bool(part), bool(part) and not need_prog, running]
1983        nxt = next((i for i, done in enumerate(states) if not done), None)
1984        for i, lab in enumerate(self.step_labels):
1985            lab.config(text=texts[i], fg=STEP_DONE if states[i] else (STEP_NEXT if i == nxt else STEP_TODO))
