1987    # ------------------------------------------------------------ YOUR CODE: folder, Python, recent programs
1988    def _code_plan(self, command):
1989        """(python, folder, note): how YOUR CODE will run. A .py file runs with the project's venv
1990        (.venv / venv / env next to it or in the project's top folder) or this Python, in the FOLDER
1991        field or the project's top folder (.git, requirements.txt... - like VS Code's Run)."""
1992        import profiler
1993        m = re.match(r'\s*(?:"([^"]+)"|(\S+))(.*)$', command or "")
1994        first = (m.group(1) or m.group(2)) if m else ""
1995        folder = self.folder_var.get().strip().strip('"')
1996        python = None
1997        script = first if first.lower().endswith((".py", ".pyw")) and os.path.isfile(first) else None
1998        if not script and os.path.isfile(first) and m:  # "python.exe" "script.py" ...
1999            m2 = re.match(r'\s*(?:"([^"]+)"|(\S+))', m.group(3))
2000            second = (m2.group(1) or m2.group(2)) if m2 else ""
2001            if second.lower().endswith(".py") and os.path.isfile(second):
2002                folder = folder or profiler.project_root(second)
2003        if script:
2004            root = profiler.project_root(script)
2005            folder = folder or root
2006            for base in dict.fromkeys([os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(script)), root, folder]):
2007                for name in (".venv", "venv", "env"):
2008                    exe = os.path.join(base, name, "Scripts" if os.name == "nt" else "bin",
2009                                       "python.exe" if os.name == "nt" else "python")
2010                    if os.path.isfile(os.path.join(base, name, "pyvenv.cfg")) and os.path.isfile(exe):
2011                        python = exe
2012                        break
2013                if python:
2014                    break
2015        if folder and not os.path.isdir(folder):
2016            return python, None, f"Folder not found: {folder}"
2017        def short(path, n=48):
2018            return path if len(path) <= n else "…" + path[-(n - 1):]
2019        if script:
2020            if python:
2021                rel = os.path.relpath(python, folder) if folder else python
2022                py_text = f"the project's venv ({rel if not rel.startswith('..') else short(python)})"
2023            else:
2024                py_text = f"this Python ({short(sys.executable, 40)})"
2025            note = f"Runs with {py_text}  ·  in {short(folder)}"
2026        elif command:
2027            where = folder or (os.path.dirname(first) if os.path.isfile(first) else "your home folder")
2028            note = f"Runs as typed  ·  in {short(where)}"
2029        else:
2030            note = ""
2031        return python, folder or None, note
2032

2038        self.plan_label.config(text=note or "Pick the file that starts your program (…), or type a command line.")
2039        self._update_steps()

2078    def _set_summary(self, text):
2079        self.summary.config(state="normal")
2080        self.summary.delete("1.0", "end")
2081        self.summary.insert("1.0", text)
2082        # the code run's slowest lines, each a link into VS Code
2083        links, self._code_links = getattr(self, "_code_links", []), []
2084        if links:
2085            self.summary.insert("end", "\n\nWhere in your code (click to open in VS Code):\n")
2086            for i, (file, line, label) in enumerate(links):
2087                tag = f"code{i}"
2088                self.summary.insert("end", f"  {label}\n", tag)
2089                self.summary.tag_config(tag, foreground=EDITOR_COLOR, underline=True)
2090                self.summary.tag_bind(tag, "<Button-1>", lambda e, f=file, n=line: self._open_in_editor(f, n))
2091                self.summary.tag_bind(tag, "<Enter>", lambda e: self.summary.config(cursor="hand2"))
2092                self.summary.tag_bind(tag, "<Leave>", lambda e: self.summary.config(cursor=""))
2093        self.summary.config(state="disabled")

2095    def _show_summary(self, result, duration):
2096        lines = [f"Result: {result}   Test: {TESTS[self.test_key]['label']} on "
2097                 f"{PARTS[self.target]['label']}   Duration: {duration:.1f} s   Machine: {self._machine_name()}", ""]
2098        if self.is_ai:
2099            lines.insert(1, f"Agent: {self.ai_steps} tool calls, {self.ai_blocked} blocked action(s)")
2100            if self.ai_done_text:
2101                lines.insert(2, f"Agent said: {self.ai_done_text}")
2102        if self.is_code:
2103            lines.insert(1, f"Program: {self.program}")
2104        findings = analysis.analyze(self.record, self.hw.get("threads"))
2105        prev = self._previous_run()  # looked up before this run is saved
2106        prev_avg = prev["averages"] if prev else {}
2107        head = f"{'Metric':<20}{'min':>11}{'avg':>11}{'peak':>11}  {'unit':<10}"
2108        if prev:
2109            head += f"{'prev avg':>11}{'change':>9}"
2110        lines.append(head)
2111        for key, label, unit, part, _ in STATS:
2112            vals = self.samples.get(key)
2113            if part in PARTS and part not in self.involved:
2114                continue
2115            if part == "wl" and not vals:
2116                continue
2117            f = FMT.get(key, "{:.2f}").format
2118            if not vals:
2119                lines.append(f"{label:<20}{'no data':>33}")
2120                continue
2121            avg = sum(vals) / len(vals)
2122            line = f"{label:<20}{f(min(vals)):>11}{f(avg):>11}{f(max(vals)):>11}  {unit:<10}"
2123            old = prev_avg.get(key)
2124            if isinstance(old, (int, float)):
2125                line += f"{f(old):>11}"
2126                if old:
2127                    pct = 100.0 * (avg - old) / abs(old)
2128                    line += f"{pct:>+8.1f}%"
2129                    if part == "wl" and abs(pct) >= 3:  # only workload results have a "better"
2130                        line += "  better" if (pct < 0) == (key in LOWER_IS_BETTER) else "  worse"
2131            lines.append(line)
2132        if prev:
2133            lines.append(f"Compared with the previous run of this test on this part ({prev.get('when', '?')}, "
2134                         f"{prev.get('result', '?')}).")
2135        lines += [""] + analysis.report(findings)
2136        self._code_links = []
2137        saved = self._save_run(result, duration, "\n".join(lines), findings)
2138        lines.append("")
2139        lines.append(f"Recorded as runs/{saved} - REPLAY watches it again, COMPARE puts it next to another run."
2140                     if saved else "Not recorded (no samples were taken).")
2141        self._set_summary("\n".join(lines))
2142

2144class CompareWindow:
2145    """Two recorded runs side by side (SRS stretch goal): the same test on two machines,
2146    or your program before and after a change. Averages with the change, one metric
2147    over time for both runs, and what the bottleneck finder says about each."""
2148    COLORS = ("#00e5ff", "#ff9f1a")  # run A, run B
2149    GW, GH = 900, 230
2150
2151    def __init__(self, root, a=None, b=None):
2152        """a, b: run file names to open with (default: newest run and an earlier one like it)."""
2153        self.runs, labels, by_file = {}, [], {}
2154        try:
2155            names = sorted((n for n in os.listdir(RUNS_DIR) if n.endswith(".json")), reverse=True)
2156        except OSError:
2157            names = []
2158        for n in names:
2159            try:
2160                with open(os.path.join(RUNS_DIR, n), "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
2161                    run = json.load(f)
2162                if not run.get("samples"):
2163                    continue
2164            except (OSError, ValueError):
2165                continue
2166            prog = run.get("program")
2167            what = ("program " + (prog if len(prog) <= 40 else "…" + prog[-39:]) if prog else
2168                    f"{run.get('test_label', '?')} on {str(run.get('part', '?')).upper()}")
2169            label = f"{run.get('when', '?')}   {run.get('machine', 'this PC')}   {what}   ({run.get('result', '?')})"
2170            while label in self.runs:
2171                label += " "
2172            self.runs[label] = run
2173            labels.append(label)
2174            by_file[n] = label
2175            run["_same"] = (run.get("test"), run.get("part"), run.get("program"))
2176        if len(labels) < 2:
2177            messagebox.showinfo("Compare runs", "Record at least two runs first (every finished test is recorded).")
2178            return
2179        top = self.top = tk.Toplevel(root)
2180        top.title("Compare runs")
2181        top.configure(bg=BG)
2182        top.geometry(f"{self.GW + 48}x860")
2183        tk.Label(top, text="COMPARE RUNS", bg=BG, fg=FG, font=(FONT, 16, "bold")).pack(anchor="w", padx=24,
2184                                                                                     pady=(14, 4))
2185        # B = newest run; A = the newest earlier run of the same test (or program), else the one before
2186        newest = self.runs[labels[0]]["_same"]
2187        older = next((lab for lab in labels[1:] if self.runs[lab]["_same"] == newest), labels[1])

2201            self.vars.append(var)

2204        tk.Label(mrow, text="GRAPH", bg=BG, fg=MUTED, font=(FONT, 10, "bold")).pack(side="left", padx=(0, 8))

2217                            highlightthickness=1, highlightbackground=LINE)

2228    def _pair(self):
2229        return self.runs[self.vars[0].get()], self.runs[self.vars[1].get()]
2230
2231    @staticmethod
2232    def _series(run, key):
2233        return [(s["t"], s[key]) for s in run["samples"] if isinstance(s.get(key), (int, float))]

2235    def refresh(self):
2236        a, b = self._pair()
2237        stats = [st for st in STATS if self._series(a, st[0]) or self._series(b, st[0])]
2238        labels = [st[1] for st in stats]
2239        menu = self.metric_menu["menu"]
2240        menu.delete(0, "end")
2241        for lab in labels:
2242            menu.add_command(label=lab, command=tk._setit(self.metric, lab, lambda *_: self.draw()))
2243        if self.metric.get() not in labels:
2244            prefer = [st[1] for st in stats if st[3] == "wl"] + [st[1] for st in stats if st[0].endswith("_util")]
2245            self.metric.set((prefer or labels or [""])[0])
2246        self.write_table(a, b, stats)
2247        self.draw()

2249    def write_table(self, a, b, stats):
2250        t = self.text
2251        t.config(state="normal")
2252        t.delete("1.0", "end")
2253
2254        def cut(v):  # long paths: the end (file name) matters more than the start
2255            v = str(v)
2256            return v if len(v) <= 46 else "…" + v[-45:]
2257
2258        def row(label, va, vb):
2259            t.insert("end", f"{label:<22}")
2260            t.insert("end", f"{cut(va):<48}", "a")
2261            t.insert("end", f"{cut(vb):<48}\n", "b")
2262
2263        row("", "A", "B")
2264        for label, key in (("When", "when"), ("Machine", "machine"), ("Test", "test_label"), ("Part", "part_name"),
2265                           ("Program", "program"), ("Result", "result")):
2266            if a.get(key) or b.get(key):
2267                row(label, a.get(key) or "-", b.get(key) or "-")
2268        da, db = a.get("duration") or 0, b.get("duration") or 0
2269        line = f"{'Duration':<22}{da:>10.1f} s{'':36}{db:>10.1f} s"
2270        if da:
2271            line += f"   {100 * (db - da) / da:+.1f}% B vs A"
2272        t.insert("end", line + "\n\n")
2273        t.insert("end", f"{'Average':<22}{'A':>12}{'B':>12}   {'unit':<10}{'B vs A':>9}\n", "head")
2274        for key, label, unit, part, _ in stats:
2275            va, vb = (a.get("averages") or {}).get(key), (b.get("averages") or {}).get(key)
2276            f = FMT.get(key, "{:.2f}").format
2277            sa = f(va) if isinstance(va, (int, float)) else "-"
2278            sb = f(vb) if isinstance(vb, (int, float)) else "-"
2279            line = f"{label:<22}{sa:>12}{sb:>12}   {unit:<10}"
2280            if isinstance(va, (int, float)) and isinstance(vb, (int, float)) and va:
2281                pct = 100.0 * (vb - va) / abs(va)
2282                line += f"{pct:>+8.1f}%"
2283                if part == "wl" and abs(pct) >= 3:
2284                    line += "  better" if (pct < 0) == (key in LOWER_IS_BETTER) else "  worse"
2285            t.insert("end", line + "\n")
2286        for name, run, tag in (("A", a, "a"), ("B", b, "b")):
2287            findings = run.get("findings")
2288            if findings is None:  # runs recorded before the bottleneck finder existed
2289                findings = analysis.analyze(run["samples"], run.get("threads"))
2290            t.insert("end", f"\n{name}: ", tag)
2291            for i, ln in enumerate(analysis.report(findings)):
2292                t.insert("end", ("" if i == 0 else "   ") + ln + "\n", "bad" if ln.lstrip().startswith("!") else ())
2293        t.config(state="disabled")

2295    def draw(self):
2296        c = self.canvas
2297        c.delete("all")
2298        stat = next((st for st in STATS if st[1] == self.metric.get()), None)
2299        if not stat:
2300            return
2301        key, label, unit = stat[0], stat[1], stat[2]
2302        series = [self._series(r, key) for r in self._pair()]
2303        if not any(series):
2304            return
2305        x0, x1, y0, y1 = 56, self.GW - 16, 18, self.GH - 28
2306        t_max = max(s[-1][0] for s in series if s) or 1.0
2307        v_max = 100.0 if unit == "%" else max(v for s in series for _, v in s) * 1.1 or 1.0
2308        for frac in (0.0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1.0):
2309            y = y1 - (y1 - y0) * frac
2310            c.create_line(x0, y, x1, y, fill="#1c1c1c", dash=(2, 4))
2311            c.create_text(x0 - 6, y, text=FMT.get(key, "{:.2f}").format(v_max * frac), anchor="e", fill=MUTED,
2312                          font=("Consolas", 8))
2313        for i in range(6):
2314            x = x0 + (x1 - x0) * i / 5
2315            c.create_text(x, y1 + 12, text=f"{t_max * i / 5:.0f} s", fill=MUTED, font=("Consolas", 8))
2316        for s, color, name in zip(series, self.COLORS, ("A", "B")):
2317            if len(s) < 2:
2318                continue
2319            step = max(1, len(s) // 800)
2320            pts = []
2321            for t_, v in s[::step]:
2322                pts += [x0 + (x1 - x0) * t_ / t_max, y1 - (y1 - y0) * min(1.0, v / v_max)]
2323            c.create_line(*pts, fill=color, width=2)
2324        c.create_text(x0 + 6, y0, text=f"{label} ({unit})" if unit else label, anchor="nw", fill=FG,
2325                      font=(FONT, 10, "bold"))
2326        c.create_text(x1 - 60, y0, text="A", anchor="ne", fill=self.COLORS[0], font=(FONT, 11, "bold"))
2327        c.create_text(x1 - 30, y0, text="B", anchor="ne", fill=self.COLORS[1], font=(FONT, 11, "bold"))
2328

2330def _code_lines(profile_path, n=6):
2331    """[(file, line, label)] for the slowest lines of a code profile, for the summary's links."""
2332    try:
2333        with open(profile_path, encoding="utf-8") as f:
2334            data = json.load(f)
2335    except (OSError, ValueError):
2336        return []
2337    root = data.get("root") or os.path.dirname(data.get("script") or "")
2338    out = []
2339    for l in (data.get("lines") or [])[:n]:
2340        try:
2341            rel = os.path.relpath(l["file"], root)
2342        except ValueError:
2343            rel = l["file"]
2344        out.append((l["file"], l["line"], f"{rel}:{l['line']}  {l['func']}  {l['seconds']:.2f} s  "
2345                    f"({100 * l['share']:.0f}% of the run)"))
2346    return out

2349def _fine_timer(on):
2350    """Windows wakes timers every 15.6 ms by default, which caps Tk's after() loop at ~48 FPS.
2351    Ask for 1 ms while the app runs (what games and media players do); undone on exit."""
2352    try:
2353        import ctypes
2354        (ctypes.windll.winmm.timeBeginPeriod if on else ctypes.windll.winmm.timeEndPeriod)(1)
2355    except (AttributeError, OSError):
2356        pass
2357
2358
2359if __name__ == "__main__":
2360    _fine_timer(True)
2361    root = tk.Tk()
2362    app = App(root)
2363    app._open_link()
2364    if "--ai-control" in sys.argv:
2365        app.toggle_ai_control()
2366    try:
2367        root.mainloop()
2368    finally:
2369        _fine_timer(False)

def mix(c1, c2, t): 
60def mix(c1, c2, t):
61    """Blend #rrggbb c1 -> c2 by t (0-1)."""
62    a, b = c1.lstrip("#"), c2.lstrip("#")
63    out = []
64    for i in (0, 2, 4):
65        x, y = int(a[i:i + 2], 16), int(b[i:i + 2], 16)
66        out.append(int(x + (y - x) * max(0.0, min(1.0, t))))
67    return "#{:02x}{:02x}{:02x}".format(*out)

70def chamfer(canvas, x0, y0, x1, y1, c=14, **kwargs):
71    """Rectangle with two cut corners (top-left, bottom-right), gaming-panel style."""
72    points = [x0 + c, y0, x1, y0, x1, y1 - c, x1 - c, y1, x0, y1, x0, y0 + c]
73    return canvas.create_polygon(points, **kwargs)

190            self.tip.destroy()
191            self.tip = None

315        if self.enabled:
316            self.entry.bind("<FocusIn>", self._on_focus_in)
317            self.entry.bind("<FocusOut>", self._on_focus_out)
318            self.entry.bind("<KeyRelease>", self._filter)
319            self.entry.bind("<Enter>", lambda e: self._set_border(self.hover_color))
320            self.entry.bind("<Leave>", lambda e: None if self._focused else self._set_border(color))
321            self.clear()
322        else:
323            self.var.set("not detected")
324            self.entry.config(state="disabled", fg=MUTED, disabledforeground=MUTED,
325                              disabledbackground=PANEL, highlightbackground=GREY)
326
327    def _set_border(self, c):
328        self.entry.config(highlightbackground=c, highlightcolor=c)
329
330    def _on_focus_in(self, event=None):
331        self._focused = True
332        self._set_border(self.hover_color)
333        if self._placeholder:
334            self.entry.delete(0, "end")
335            self.entry.config(fg=FG)
336            self._placeholder = False
337        self._show_results(self.options)
338
339    def _on_focus_out(self, event=None):
340        self._focused = False
341        self._set_border(self.color)
342        self.entry.after(150, self._maybe_hide)
343        if not self.var.get():
344            self.clear()
345
346    def _maybe_hide(self):
347        if self.entry.focus_get() not in (self.entry, self.listbox):
348            self._hide_results()
349
350    def _filter(self, event=None):
351        q = self.var.get().strip().lower()
352        matches = [o for o in self.options if q in o.lower()] if q else self.options
353        self._show_results(matches)
354
355    def _show_results(self, matches):
356        self._no_match = not matches
357        self.listbox.delete(0, "end")
358        for m in (matches or ["No matches"]):
359            self.listbox.insert("end", m)
360        self.listbox.config(height=min(3, max(1, len(matches))))
361        self.listbox.place(in_=self.entry, x=0, rely=1.0, y=2, relwidth=1.0)
362        self.listbox.lift()
363
364    def _hide_results(self):
365        self.listbox.place_forget()
366
367    def _on_select(self, event=None):
368        sel = self.listbox.curselection()
369        if not sel or self._no_match:
370            return
371        value = self.listbox.get(sel[0])
372        self.set_value(value)
373        self._hide_results()
374        self.entry.master.focus_set()
375        self.on_pick(self.key, value)
376
377    def set_value(self, value):
378        self._placeholder = False
379        self.entry.delete(0, "end")
380        self.entry.insert(0, value)
381        self.entry.config(fg=FG)
382
383    def clear(self):
384        self.entry.delete(0, "end")
385        self.entry.insert(0, f"Search {self.key.upper()}...")
386        self.entry.config(fg=MUTED)
387        self._placeholder = True
388        self._hide_results()

Type to filter, click a result to pick it. The result list floats over the layout (child of overlay) so it never pushes widgets around.

 668    @staticmethod
 669    def _options_for(hw):
 670        """Search options per part from a detect_hardware() report."""
 671        return {
 672            "ram": [hw["ram"]] if hw.get("ram") else [],
 673            "cpu": [hw["cpu"]] if hw.get("cpu") else [],
 674            "gpu": list(hw.get("gpus") or []),
 675            "board": [hw["board"]] if hw.get("board") else [],
 676            "disk": [d["label"] for d in hw.get("disks") or []],
 677        }
 678
 679    def _build_combos(self):
 680        for i, key in enumerate(ORDER):
 681            c = SearchCombo(self.combo_row, self.outer, key, self.options[key], PARTS[key]["color"],
 682                            self._on_combo)
 683            c.frame.grid(row=0, column=i, padx=6, sticky="new")
 684            self.combos[key] = c
 685
 686    def _machine_name(self):
 687        return self.hw.get("machine") or "?"
 688
 689    def _show_target(self):
 690        self.target_lbl.config(text=f"THIS PC  {self._machine_name()}", fg=FG)
 691
 692    def _apply_hardware(self):
 693        """The target machine changed: rebuild the part list, search boxes and diagram."""
 694        self.options = self._options_for(self.hw)
 695        if self.selected is not None:
 696            self.canvas.itemconfig(self.shapes[self.selected][0], width=2)
 697        self.selected = self.selected_value = None
 698        self.gpu_index = self.disk_index = 0
 699        for c in self.combos.values():
 700            c.listbox.destroy()
 701            c.frame.destroy()
 702        self.combos = {}
 703        self._build_combos()
 704        for key in ORDER:
 705            if self.options[key]:
 706                self._light_up(key)
 707            else:
 708                self._grey_out(key)
 709        self._clear_readout()
 710        self._build_core_strip()
 711        self._show_target()

 713    def _build_core_strip(self):
 714        """One small bar per logical CPU inside the CPU box: a single lit bar among dark
 715        ones is serial code, all lit is parallel code. Many cores share bars (max 64)."""
 716        self.canvas.delete("cores")
 717        n = min(int(self.hw.get("threads") or 0), 64) if self.options["cpu"] else 0
 718        self.core_bars, self.core_lv, self._core_col = [], [0.0] * n, {}
 719        if not n:
 720            return
 721        x0, y0, x1, y1 = PARTS["cpu"]["rect"]
 722        bx0, bx1 = x0 + 16, x1 - 16
 723        self.core_box = (y1 - 58, y1 - 37)  # top, bottom of the bars
 724        top, bot = self.core_box
 725        w = (bx1 - bx0) / n
 726        gap = 1 if w > 3 else 0
 727        for i in range(n):
 728            xa, xb = bx0 + i * w + gap, bx0 + (i + 1) * w - gap
 729            self.canvas.create_rectangle(xa, top, xb, bot, fill="#121a20", outline="", tags=("part_cpu", "cores"))
 730            self.core_bars.append(self.canvas.create_rectangle(xa, bot, xb, bot, fill=PARTS["cpu"]["color"],
 731                                                               outline="", tags=("part_cpu", "cores")))
 732

 744    # ------------------------------------------------------------ editor link (VS Code)
 745    def _open_link(self):
 746        """The editor link: a token-protected local API on a free port, published in app.json so the
 747        VS Code extension connects by itself. No banners or pauses: you started it from the editor."""
 748        try:
 749            self.link = control.ControlServer(port=0, token_file=None, actions=control.EDITOR_ACTIONS)
 750            control.publish_link(self.link)
 751        except OSError as e:
 752            self.link = None
 753            self._log(f"VS Code link unavailable: {e}", "info")
 754
 755    def _drain_link(self):
 756        while True:
 757            try:
 758                action, args, reply = self.link.requests.get_nowait()
 759            except queue.Empty:
 760                return
 761            if action not in ("state", "summary"):
 762                desc, _ = self._ai_describe(action, args)
 763                self._log(f"💻 VS Code → {desc}", "editor")
 764            messagebox.notes = []
 765            self.editor_busy = True
 766            try:
 767                reply.put(self._ai_do(action, args))
 768            except Exception as e:  # report, never kill the UI loop
 769                reply.put((500, {"error": f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"}))
 770            finally:
 771                self.editor_busy = False
 772
 773    def _open_in_editor(self, file, line):
 774        """A line of the user's code in VS Code (vscode://file/...), else the file itself."""
 775        uri = "vscode://file/" + os.path.abspath(file).replace("\\", "/") + f":{line}"
 776        try:
 777            if sys.platform == "win32":
 778                os.startfile(uri)
 779            else:
 780                subprocess.Popen(["xdg-open" if sys.platform != "darwin" else "open", uri])
 781        except OSError as e:
 782            self._log(f"Can't open {file}:{line} in VS Code: {e}", "blocked")
 783

 803    def _flash(self, widget, times=3):
 804        """Blink a widget the AI is 'pressing' so the action is easy to see."""
 805        try:
 806            normal = widget.cget("bg")
 807        except tk.TclError:
 808            return
 809
 810        def step(n):
 811            try:
 812                widget.config(bg=AI_COLOR if n % 2 == 0 else normal)
 813            except tk.TclError:
 814                return
 815            if n < 2 * times - 1:
 816                self.root.after(120, step, n + 1)
 817        step(0)
 818
 819    def _drain_control(self):
 820        """AI requests -> UI thread. 'state' answers at once; every other action is shown
 821        first (banner, log, flashing control) and done a moment later, one at a time."""
 822        while True:
 823            try:
 824                item = self.control.requests.get_nowait()
 825            except queue.Empty:
 826                break
 827            if item[0] in ("state", "summary", "runs"):
 828                action, args, reply = item
 829                reply.put(self._ai_do(action, args))
 830            else:
 831                self._ai_queue.append(item)
 832        if self._ai_busy or not self._ai_queue:
 833            return
 834        action, args, reply = self._ai_queue.popleft()
 835        desc, widget = self._ai_describe(action, args)
 836        self._ai_busy = True
 837        self.ai_banner.config(text=f"🤖 AI: {desc}")
 838        self._log(f"🤖 AI → {desc}", "ai")
 839        if widget is not None:
 840            self._flash(widget)
 841
 842        def run():
 843            try:
 844                reply.put(self._ai_do(action, args))
 845            except Exception as e:  # report, never kill the UI loop
 846                reply.put((500, {"error": f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"}))
 847            finally:
 848                self._ai_busy = False
 849                if self.control:
 850                    self.root.after(2500, lambda: self.control and not self._ai_busy and
 851                                    self.ai_banner.config(text="🤖 AI CONTROL ON"))
 852        self.root.after(450, run)  # long enough to see what is about to happen
 853
 854    def _ai_describe(self, action, args):
 855        tests = {k: t["short"] for k, t in TESTS.items()}
 856        if action == "select":
 857            part = str(args.get("part", "")).lower()
 858            w = self.combos[part].entry if part in self.combos else None
 859            return f"select {part.upper()}" + (f" ({args['name']})" if args.get("name") else ""), w
 860        if action == "test":
 861            key = self._find_test(args.get("test"))
 862            w = self.radios[list(TESTS).index(key)] if key else None
 863            return f"choose test {tests.get(key, args.get('test'))}", w
 864        if action == "program":
 865            return f"program: {args.get('command', '')}", self.program_entry
 866        if action == "ai_task":
 867            return f"AI task: {args.get('task', '')}", self.goal_menu
 868        if action == "start":
 869            return "press START" + (" (and confirm)" if args.get("confirm") else ""), self.btn_start
 870        if action == "stop":
 871            return "press STOP", self.btn_stop
 872        if action == "replay":
 873            return f"replay {args.get('run', '')}", self.btn_replay
 874        if action == "compare":
 875            return "open COMPARE", self.btn_compare
 876        return action, None
 877
 878    @staticmethod
 879    def _find_test(name):
 880        n = str(name or "").strip().lower()
 881        for k, t in TESTS.items():
 882            if n in (k, t["short"].lower(), t["label"].lower()):
 883                return k
 884        return None
 885
 886    def _ai_state(self):
 887        readings = {}
 888        for key, label, unit, part, src in STATS:
 889            text = self.stat_val[key].cget("text")
 890            if text not in ("—", ""):
 891                readings[label] = text
 892        return {
 893            "machine": self.hw.get("machine"),
 894            "parts": self.options, "selected": {"part": self.selected, "name": self.selected_value},
 895            "test": self.test_var.get(), "tests": {k: t["label"] for k, t in TESTS.items()},
 896            "ai_task": self.goal_ids.get(self.goal_var.get()), "ai_tasks": {v: k for k, v in self.goal_ids.items()},
 897            "program": self.program_var.get(), "running": self.running, "replay": bool(self.replay),
 898            "elapsed_s": round(time.monotonic() - self.t_start, 1) if self.running else None,
 899            "status": self.status.cget("text"), "readings": readings,
 900        }
 901
 902    def _ai_do(self, action, args):
 903        """One AI action on the UI thread -> (HTTP code, body)."""
 904        messagebox.notes = []
 905        ok = lambda **kw: (200, dict(kw, status=self.status.cget("text"), messages=messagebox.notes))  # noqa: E731
 906        bad = lambda msg, **kw: (400, dict(kw, error=msg, status=self.status.cget("text"),  # noqa: E731
 907                                           messages=messagebox.notes))
 908        if action == "state":
 909            return 200, self._ai_state()
 910        if action == "summary":
 911            return 200, {"summary": self.summary.get("1.0", "end").strip()}
 912        if action == "runs":
 913            out = []
 914            for n in sorted((n for n in os.listdir(RUNS_DIR) if n.endswith(".json")), reverse=True) \
 915                    if os.path.isdir(RUNS_DIR) else []:
 916                try:
 917                    with open(os.path.join(RUNS_DIR, n), "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
 918                        r = json.load(f)
 919                except (OSError, ValueError):
 920                    continue
 921                out.append({"run": n, "when": r.get("when"), "machine": r.get("machine"),
 922                            "test": r.get("test_label"), "part": r.get("part"), "program": r.get("program"),
 923                            "result": r.get("result"), "duration_s": r.get("duration"),
 924                            "bottlenecks": [f"{100 * f['share']:.0f}% {f['title']}" for f in r.get("findings") or []]})
 925            return 200, {"runs": out}
 926        busy = self.running and action not in ("stop",)
 927        if busy:
 928            return bad("a test is running - stop it or wait for it first")
 929        if action == "select":
 930            part = str(args.get("part", "")).lower()
 931            part = next((k for k in PARTS if part in (k, PARTS[k]["label"].lower())), None)
 932            if not part:
 933                return bad(f"part must be one of {list(PARTS)}")
 934            if not self.options[part]:
 935                return bad(f"{part} is not detected on this machine")
 936            name = str(args.get("name") or "").lower()
 937            value = next((o for o in self.options[part] if name and name in o.lower()), None)
 938            if name and value is None:
 939                return bad(f"no {part} matching {args['name']!r}", choices=self.options[part])
 940            if value:
 941                self.combos[part].set_value(value)
 942                self._select(part, value)
 943            else:
 944                self._on_diagram_click(part)
 945            return ok(selected={"part": self.selected, "name": self.selected_value})
 946        if action == "test":
 947            key = self._find_test(args.get("test"))
 948            if not key:
 949                return bad("unknown test", tests={k: t["short"] for k, t in TESTS.items()})
 950            self.test_var.set(key)
 951            return ok(test=key)
 952        if action == "program":
 953            self.test_var.set("code")
 954            self.program_var.set(str(args.get("command", "")))
 955            return ok(program=self.program_var.get())
 956        if action == "ai_task":
 957            t = str(args.get("task", "")).lower()
 958            hit = next((title for title, gid in self.goal_ids.items() if t in (gid, title.lower())), None)
 959            if not hit:
 960                return bad("unknown AI task", tasks=list(self.goal_ids.values()))
 961            self.test_var.set("ai")
 962            self.goal_var.set(hit)
 963            return ok(ai_task=self.goal_ids[hit])
 964        if action == "start":
 965            messagebox.confirm = bool(args.get("confirm"))
 966            try:
 967                self.start_test()
 968            finally:
 969                messagebox.confirm = False
 970            if self.running:
 971                return ok(running=True)
 972            asked = [n for n in messagebox.notes if n["kind"] == "question"]
 973            if asked and not args.get("confirm"):
 974                return bad("needs confirmation - call start again with confirm=true to go ahead",
 975                           question=asked[-1]["text"])
 976            return bad("the test did not start")
 977        if action == "stop":
 978            if not self.running:
 979                return bad("nothing is running")
 980            self.stop_test("stopped from VS Code" if self.editor_busy else "stopped by AI")
 981            return ok(stopped=True)
 982        if action == "replay":
 983            path = os.path.join(RUNS_DIR, os.path.basename(str(args.get("run", ""))))
 984            if not os.path.isfile(path):
 985                return bad("no such run - see /runs")
 986            self.start_replay(path)
 987            return ok(running=self.running)
 988        if action == "compare":
 989            CompareWindow(self.root, args.get("a"), args.get("b"))
 990            return ok(opened=True)
 991        return bad("unknown action")
 992
 993    # ------------------------------------------------------------ diagram
 994    def _draw_backdrop(self):
 995        c = self.canvas
 996        for x in range(0, CANVAS_W + 1, 22):
 997            c.create_line(x, 0, x, CANVAS_H, fill="#0e0e0e")
 998        for y in range(0, CANVAS_H + 1, 22):
 999            c.create_line(0, y, CANVAS_W, y, fill="#0e0e0e")
1000        c.create_line(0, 1, CANVAS_W, 1, fill=LINE)
1001        c.create_line(0, CANVAS_H - 1, CANVAS_W, CANVAS_H - 1, fill=LINE)
1002
1003    def _trace_points(self, a, b):
1004        """Polyline for the circuit trace joining part a to part b."""
1005        ra, rb = PARTS[a]["rect"], PARTS[b]["rect"]
1006        span = ORDER.index(b) - ORDER.index(a)
1007        if span > 1:  # bus routed under the boxes in between; longer buses run deeper
1008            shift = (span - 2) * 22 - 11
1009            xa, xb = (ra[0] + ra[2]) / 2 - shift, (rb[0] + rb[2]) / 2 + shift
1010            y = ra[3] + 14 + (span - 2) * 18
1011            return [xa, ra[3], xa, y, xa + 8, y + 8, xb - 8, y + 8, xb, y, xb, rb[3]]
1012        y = (ra[1] + ra[3]) / 2
1013        return [ra[2], y - 22, ra[2] + 14, y - 22, ra[2] + 22, y - 30, rb[0] - 22, y - 30,
1014                rb[0] - 14, y - 22, rb[0], y - 22]
1015
1016    def _draw_trace(self, a, b):
1017        pts = self._trace_points(a, b)
1018        # dim static copper underneath, animated dashes on top
1019        self.canvas.create_line(*pts, fill="#161616", width=5)
1020        item = self.canvas.create_line(*pts, fill=GREY, width=2, dash=(8, 6))
1021        for x, y in (pts[0:2], pts[-2:]):
1022            self.canvas.create_rectangle(x - 3, y - 3, x + 3, y + 3, fill=GREY, outline="")
1023        return item
1024
1025    def _draw_part(self, key):
1026        p = PARTS[key]
1027        x0, y0, x1, y1 = p["rect"]
1028        color = p["color"]
1029        tag = f"part_{key}"
1030        # glow halos (outline-only, recolored from live utilization), outermost first
1031        halos = []
1032        for pad in (7, 4):
1033            halos.append(chamfer(self.canvas, x0 - pad, y0 - pad, x1 + pad, y1 + pad, c=14 + pad,
1034                                 fill="", outline=BG, width=1, tags=tag))
1035        rect = chamfer(self.canvas, x0, y0, x1, y1, c=14, fill=PANEL, outline=mix(color, BG, 0.5),
1036                       width=2, tags=tag)
1037        # scanlines + top ticks for texture
1038        for y in range(y0 + 6, y1, 6):
1039            self.canvas.create_line(x0 + 3, y, x1 - 3, y, fill="#131313", tags=tag)
1040        for i in range(10):
1041            x = x0 + 24 + i * 7
1042            self.canvas.create_line(x, y0 + 2, x, y0 + (7 if i % 3 == 0 else 4), fill=mix(color, BG, 0.4), tags=tag)
1043        # corner brackets (bottom-left / top-right)
1044        for (cx, cy, dx, dy) in ((x0, y1, 1, -1), (x1, y0, -1, 1)):
1045            self.canvas.create_line(cx, cy + dy * 14, cx, cy, cx + dx * 14, cy, fill=color, width=2, tags=tag)
1046        text = self.canvas.create_text(x0 + 18, y0 + 28, text=p["label"], anchor="w", fill=color,
1047                                       font=(FONT, 24, "bold"), tags=tag)
1048        # scrolling history graph (behind the big number): guide lines + the trace itself
1049        # the CPU box keeps room under its graph for the per-core bars
1050        gx0, gx1, gy0, gy1 = x0 + 16, x1 - 16, y0 + 56, y1 - (64 if key == "cpu" else 46)
1051        for frac in (0.0, 0.5, 1.0):
1052            gy = gy1 - (gy1 - gy0) * frac
1053            self.canvas.create_line(gx0, gy, gx1, gy, fill="#1c1c1c", dash=(2, 4), tags=tag)
1054        graph = self.canvas.create_line(gx0, gy1, gx1, gy1, fill=mix(color, BG, 0.4), width=2, tags=tag)
1055        self.graph_box[key] = (gx0, gx1, gy0, gy1)
1056        self.history[key] = collections.deque([0.0] * HISTORY, maxlen=HISTORY)
1057        self.graphs[key] = graph
1058        sub = self.canvas.create_text((x0 + x1) / 2, (gy0 + gy1) / 2, text="", fill=FG,
1059                                      font=(FONT, 36, "bold"), tags=tag)
1060        # segmented meter
1061        bx0, bx1, by = x0 + 16, x1 - 16, y1 - 30
1062        seg_w = (bx1 - bx0) / SEGMENTS
1063        segs = [self.canvas.create_rectangle(bx0 + i * seg_w + 1, by, bx0 + (i + 1) * seg_w - 1, by + 9,
1064                                             fill="#1a1a1a", outline="", tags=tag)
1065                for i in range(SEGMENTS)]
1066        self.shapes[key] = (rect, text, sub)
1067        self.bars[key] = segs
1068        self.glows[key] = halos
1069        self.canvas.tag_bind(tag, "<Button-1>", lambda e, k=key: self._on_diagram_click(k))
1070        self.canvas.tag_bind(tag, "<Enter>", lambda e: self.canvas.config(cursor="hand2"))
1071        self.canvas.tag_bind(tag, "<Leave>", lambda e: self.canvas.config(cursor=""))
1072
1073    def _grey_out(self, key):
1074        rect, text, sub = self.shapes[key]
1075        self.canvas.itemconfig(rect, outline=GREY, fill=PANEL, width=2)
1076        self.canvas.itemconfig(sub, text="NOT DETECTED", font=(FONT, 13, "bold"), fill=MUTED)
1077        self.canvas.itemconfig(text, fill=MUTED)
1078        for seg in self.bars[key]:
1079            self.canvas.itemconfig(seg, fill="#1a1a1a")
1080        self._lit[key] = 0
1081        for halo in self.glows[key]:
1082            self.canvas.itemconfig(halo, outline=BG)
1083
1084    def _light_up(self, key):
1085        rect, text, sub = self.shapes[key]
1086        self.canvas.itemconfig(text, fill=PARTS[key]["color"])
1087        self.canvas.itemconfig(sub, text="", font=(FONT, 36, "bold"), fill=FG)

1089    def _on_diagram_click(self, key):
1090        if not self.options[key]:
1091            return
1092        value = self.selected_value if key == self.selected else self.options[key][0]
1093        self.combos[key].set_value(value)
1094        self._select(key, value)
1095
1096    def _on_combo(self, key, value):
1097        self._select(key, value)
1098
1099    def _select(self, key, value):
1100        if key == self.selected and value == self.selected_value:
1101            return  # UC-4 alt: reselect same part, nothing changes
1102        if self.running:
1103            self.stop_test("stopped: selection changed")  # FR-4
1104        if self.selected is not None and self.selected != key:
1105            self.canvas.itemconfig(self.shapes[self.selected][0], width=2)
1106            self.combos[self.selected].clear()
1107        self.selected, self.selected_value = key, value
1108        if key == "gpu":
1109            self.gpu_index = self.options["gpu"].index(value)
1110        elif key == "disk":
1111            self.disk_index = self.options["disk"].index(value)
1112        self.canvas.itemconfig(self.shapes[key][0], width=3)  # colour is set per frame in _animate
1113        self._set_status(f"Selected: {PARTS[key]['label']} — {value}")
1114        self._sync_controls()
1115
1116    def _set_status(self, text, color=FG):
1117        self.status.config(text=text, fg=color)
1118
1119    # ------------------------------------------------------------ run control
1120    def start_test(self):
1121        if self.running:
1122            return
1123        if self.selected is None:
1124            self._fail("Select a component first (click a part or search for it).")
1125            return
1126        test = TESTS[self.test_var.get()]
1127        script = test["targets"].get(self.selected)
1128        if script is None:
1129            ok = ", ".join(PARTS[p]["label"] for p in test["targets"])
1130            self._fail(f"The {test['label']} can't target {PARTS[self.selected]['label']}. "
1131                       f"It works on: {ok}.")
1132            return
1133        gpus = self.hw.get("gpu_info") or []
1134        gpu_sel = self.gpu_index if gpus else None
1135        if self.selected == "board":
1136            # the board's readings are the PCIe link of an NVIDIA GPU: use the chosen GPU if it is one
1137            nv = [i for i, g in enumerate(gpus) if g["kind"] == "nvml"]
1138            if not nv:
1139                self._fail("The board's readings come from the PCIe link of an NVIDIA GPU (NVML), and this "
1140                           "machine has none - there would be nothing to show.")
1141                return
1142            gpu_sel = gpu_sel if gpu_sel in nv else nv[0]
1143        gpu = gpus[gpu_sel] if gpu_sel is not None else None
1144        if script == "mlgpu" and (not gpu or gpu["kind"] != "nvml"):
1145            self._fail("The ML test on a GPU needs an NVIDIA GPU (it trains with CUDA). "
1146                       "Pick an NVIDIA GPU, or run the ML test on the CPU.")
1147            return
1148        # UC-14 alt a: warn before the test when the target's temperature can't be read
1149        if self.selected == "cpu" and not self.hw.get("cpu_temp") \
1150                and time.monotonic() - self._lhm_probed > 30:
1151            self._lhm_probed = time.monotonic()  # LibreHardwareMonitor may have been started after the app
1152            self.hw["cpu_temp"] = telemetry.probe_lhm() is not None
1153        if self.selected == "cpu" and not self.hw.get("cpu_temp"):
1154            why = "on Windows it needs LibreHardwareMonitor running as administrator"
1155            if not messagebox.askokcancel(
1156                    "No CPU temperature",
1157                    f"CPU temperature isn't readable ({why}), so there is no thermal safety abort "
1158                    "for the CPU. Continue?"):
1159                return
1160        if self.selected == "gpu" and gpu and gpu["kind"] == "pdh" and not telemetry.LHM and not \
1161                messagebox.askokcancel(
1162                    "No GPU temperature",
1163                    "This GPU's temperature isn't readable (for AMD / Intel GPUs it needs LibreHardwareMonitor "
1164                    "running as administrator), so there is no thermal safety abort for it. Continue?"):
1165            return
1166
1167        is_ai, is_code = script == "agent", script == "usercode"
1168        command = self.program_var.get().strip() if is_code else None
1169        if is_code and not command:
1170            self._fail("Type the command that starts your program in PROGRAM (or pick a file with …).")
1171            return
1172        cmd = None
1173        if is_ai:
1174            # UC-7 precondition: Ollama up on localhost with a supported model installed
1175            installed = agent.ollama_models()
1176            if installed is None:
1177                self._fail("Ollama isn't running. Start it (open the Ollama app, or run 'ollama serve') "
1178                           "and press Start again.")
1179                return
1180            model = agent.pick_model(installed)

1183                return
1184            workdir = os.path.join(AI_DIR, datetime.datetime.now().strftime("run-%Y%m%d-%H%M%S"))
1185            try:
1186                os.makedirs(workdir)
1187            except OSError as e:
1188                self._fail(f"Can't create the agent's working folder: {e}")
1189                return
1190            self.duration = test.get("seconds", TEST_SECONDS)
1191            cmd = [os.path.join(HERE, "agent.py"), workdir, model,
1192                   self.goal_ids[self.goal_var.get()], str(self.duration)]
1193        else:
1194            self.duration = test.get("seconds", TEST_SECONDS)
1195            cmd = [os.path.join(HERE, "workloads.py"), script, str(self.duration)]
1196            if script == "disk":
1197                folder = self._disk_test_folder()
1198                if folder is None:
1199                    self._fail("This disk has no drive letter, so there is nowhere to put the test file.")
1200                    return
1201                cmd.append(folder)
1202            elif is_code:
1203                cmd.append(command)
1204                self._remember_program(command)
1205
1206        self.script = script
1207        self.is_ai, self.is_code = is_ai, is_code
1208        self.program, self.code_exit = command, None
1209        self.test_key = self.test_var.get()
1210        self.target = self.selected
1211        self.target_name = self.selected_value
1212        involved = dict.fromkeys((self.target,) + OBSERVED[script])
1213        self.involved = tuple(p for p in involved if not (is_ai or is_code) or self.options[p])
1214        self.wl, self.wl_time, self.wl_error, self.wl_got_data = {}, 0.0, None, False
1215        self.samples = {}
1216        self.record = []
1217        self.last_t = None
1218        self.peak_gbps = 0.0
1219        self.peak_io = 0.0
1220        self.lost_since = None
1221        self.msg_unavail = set()
1222        self.ai_steps = self.ai_blocked = 0
1223        self._input_hint = False
1224        self.ai_done_text = self.ai_stop_text = None
1225        while not self.events.empty():
1226            self.events.get_nowait()
1227        if is_ai:
1228            self._log("", None, clear=True)
1229            self._log(f"Working folder: {workdir}", "info")
1230        elif is_code:
1231            self._log("", None, clear=True)
1232            self._log(f"Running: {command}", "info")
1233            py, folder, note = self._code_plan(command)
1234            self._log(f"  {note}", "info")
1235        self.sample_times.clear()

1237        disks = self.hw.get("disks") or []

1240            env = None

1242                env = dict(os.environ, CUDA_DEVICE_ORDER="PCI_BUS_ID", CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=str(gpu["index"]))
1243            if is_code:

1245                env = dict(os.environ, HCV_PYTHON=py or "", HCV_CWD=folder or "")
1246            self.proc = subprocess.Popen(
1247                [sys.executable] + cmd, env=env,
1248                stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL, text=True,
1249                creationflags=getattr(subprocess, "CREATE_NO_WINDOW", 0),
1250            )
1251        except OSError as e:

1253            return
1254        threading.Thread(target=self._read_proc, args=(self.proc,), daemon=True).start()
1255
1256        self.poller = telemetry.Poller(gpu, disk)

1266    def _disk_test_folder(self):
1267        """A writable folder on the selected disk for the I/O test file (None = no drive letter)."""
1268        letters = self.hw["disks"][self.disk_index]["letters"]
1269        tmp = tempfile.gettempdir()
1270        if tmp[:1].upper() in letters:
1271            return tmp  # the system drive's root usually isn't writable without admin
1272        return f"{letters[0]}:\\" if letters else None

1275    def start_replay(self, path=None):
1276        """Play a recorded run back through the diagram and readout, clearly marked as a replay."""
1277        if self.running:
1278            return

1281                                                  filetypes=[("Recorded run", "*.json")])
1282        if not path:
1283            return
1284        try:
1285            with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
1286                run = json.load(f)
1287            samples = run["samples"]
1288            if not samples or run["part"] not in PARTS or not all("t" in s for s in samples):
1289                raise ValueError("no samples in it")
1290        except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError) as e:
1291            self._fail(f"Can't replay {os.path.basename(path)}: {e}")
1292            return
1293        self.replay = run
1294        self.script, self.is_ai, self.is_code = run.get("script"), False, False
1295        self.target = run["part"]
1296        self.involved = tuple(p for p in run.get("involved", [run["part"]]) if p in PARTS)
1297        self.duration = samples[-1]["t"]
1298        self.wl, self.last_t, self.peak_gbps, self.peak_io = {}, None, 0.0, 0.0
1299        self.sample_times.clear()
1300        self.proc = None
1301        self.poller = Replay(samples)
1302        self.poller.start()
1303        self.running = True
1304        self.t_start = time.monotonic()
1305        self.btn_start.config(state="disabled")
1306        self.btn_stop.config(state="normal")
1307        self._sync_controls()
1308        self._set_summary(f"REPLAY - recorded {run.get('when', '?')} on {run.get('part_name', '?')}\n"
1309                          + run.get("summary", ""))

1311    def _save_run(self, result, duration, summary, findings):
1312        """Write this run's samples to RUNS_DIR; returns the file name (None if it couldn't be saved)."""
1313        if not self.record:
1314            return None
1315        now = datetime.datetime.now()
1316        name = f"run-{now:%Y%m%d-%H%M%S}-{self.test_key}-{self.target}.json"
1317        run = {"version": 2, "when": f"{now:%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S}", "machine": self._machine_name(),
1318               "test": self.test_key,
1319               "test_label": TESTS[self.test_key]["label"], "script": self.script,
1320               "part": self.target, "part_name": self.target_name, "involved": list(self.involved),
1321               "hardware": self.options, "result": result, "duration": round(duration, 2),
1322               "program": self.program, "threads": self.hw.get("threads"),
1323               # wall clock at t=0 of the samples: lines them up with a profile of the same run
1324               "started_epoch": time.time() - (time.monotonic() - self.t_start),
1325               "averages": {k: sum(v) / len(v) for k, v in self.samples.items() if v},
1326               "findings": findings, "summary": summary, "samples": self.record}
1327        try:
1328            os.makedirs(RUNS_DIR, exist_ok=True)
1329            with open(os.path.join(RUNS_DIR, name), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
1330                json.dump(run, f)
1331        except OSError:
1332            return None
1333        self._link_profile(run, name)
1334        return name
1335
1336    def _link_profile(self, run, name):
1337        """YOUR CODE that ran the line profiler (VS Code: Profile in the Hardware Visualizer): this
1338        recording and its bottlenecks go into the profile too, so the editor shows them per line."""
1339        import profiler
1340        out = profiler.profile_of_command(self.program) if self.test_key == "code" else None
1341        if not out or not os.path.isfile(out):
1342            return
1343        try:
1344            if profiler.link_visualizer_run(out, run, name):
1345                self._log(f"Linked this recording to the code profile {out}", "info")
1346                self._code_links = _code_lines(out)
1347        except Exception as e:  # the run itself is saved either way
1348            self._log(f"Couldn't link the recording to {out}: {e}", "blocked")
1349
1350    def _previous_run(self):
1351        """Newest saved run of the same test on the same part and hardware, or None."""
1352        try:
1353            names = sorted((n for n in os.listdir(RUNS_DIR)
1354                            if n.endswith(f"-{self.test_key}-{self.target}.json")), reverse=True)
1355        except OSError:
1356            return None
1357        for n in names:
1358            try:
1359                with open(os.path.join(RUNS_DIR, n), "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
1360                    run = json.load(f)
1361            except (OSError, ValueError):
1362                continue
1363            machine = run.get("machine", self.local_hw.get("machine"))  # v1 runs were all on this PC
1364            if (run.get("part_name") == self.target_name and machine == self._machine_name()
1365                    and run.get("program") == self.program and run.get("averages")):
1366                return run
1367        return None

1369    def _sync_controls(self):
1370        """Radios lock while a test runs; the AI task menu is live only for an idle AI selection."""
1371        running = getattr(self, "running", False)
1372        for b in (self.btn_replay, self.btn_compare):
1373            b.config(state="disabled" if running else "normal")
1374        for k, r in zip(TESTS, self.radios):
1375            r.config(state="disabled" if running or not self._test_fits(k) else "normal")
1376        test = self.test_var.get()
1377        if not running and not self._test_fits(test):  # the part changed: pick a test that fits it
1378            fit = next((k for k in TESTS if self._test_fits(k)), None)
1379            if fit and fit != test:
1380                self.test_var.set(fit)  # calls back here
1381                return
1382        for row in (self.goalrow, self.coderow, self.hintrow):
1383            row.pack_forget()
1384        if test == "ai":
1385            self.goalrow.pack(side="left")
1386        elif test == "code":
1387            self.coderow.pack(side="left")
1388        else:
1389            self.hintrow.config(text=f"{TESTS[test]['label']} - {TEST_SECONDS} s on the selected part")
1390            self.hintrow.pack(side="left")
1391        self.goal_menu.config(state="disabled" if running else "normal")
1392        self.program_entry.config(state="disabled" if running else "normal")
1393        self.btn_browse.config(state="disabled" if running else "normal")
1394        for w in (self.folder_entry, self.btn_folder, self.btn_recent):
1395            w.config(state="disabled" if running else "normal")
1396        self.plan_label.pack_forget()
1397        if test == "code":
1398            self.plan_label.pack(side="left")
1399            self._show_plan()
1400        self._update_steps()

1402    def _log(self, text, tag, clear=False):
1403        self.log.config(state="normal")
1404        if clear:
1405            self.log.delete("1.0", "end")
1406        if text:
1407            self.log.insert("end", text + "\n", tag)
1408            self.log.see("end")
1409        self.log.config(state="disabled")

1411    def _drain_events(self):
1412        """Agent events -> log (UI thread only)."""
1413        while True:
1414            try:
1415                d = self.events.get_nowait()
1416            except queue.Empty:
1417                return
1418            ev, text = d.get("ev"), str(d.get("text", ""))
1419            if ev == "tool":
1420                self.ai_steps += 1
1421                self._log(f"▶ {text}", "tool")
1422            elif ev == "blocked":
1423                self.ai_blocked += 1
1424                self._log(f"⛔ BLOCKED: {text}", "blocked")
1425            elif ev == "done":
1426                self.ai_done_text = text
1427                self._log(f"✔ {text}", "done")
1428            elif ev == "timeout":
1429                self._log(f"⏱ {text}", "blocked")
1430            elif ev == "stopped":  # quit without calling finish: not a completed task
1431                self.ai_stop_text = text
1432                self._log(f"■ {text}", "blocked")
1433            elif ev == "result":
1434                self._log("  " + text.replace("\n", "\n  "), "result")
1435            elif ev == "out":
1436                self._log(text, "say")
1437                if "EOFError" in text and not self._input_hint:
1438                    self._input_hint = True
1439                    self._log("■ Your program asked for keyboard input (input()), which the visualizer can't type. "
1440                              "Give it the input as arguments or a file - or run it from VS Code's yellow ▶ "
1441                              "(it runs in a terminal there, where input() works).", "blocked")
1442            elif ev == "exit":
1443                self.code_exit = text
1444                self._log(f"■ {text}", "done")
1445            else:
1446                self._log(text, "say")
1447
1448    def _read_proc(self, proc):
1449        for line in proc.stdout:
1450            try:
1451                d = json.loads(line)
1452            except ValueError:
1453                continue
1454            if "ev" in d:
1455                self.events.put(d)
1456            elif "error" in d:
1457                self.wl_error = d["error"]
1458            else:
1459                self.wl = d
1460                self.wl_time = time.monotonic()
1461                self.wl_got_data = True
1462
1463    def _kill_tree(self):
1464        """Stop the workload; returns True if it had to be force-terminated (FR-10)."""
1465        p = self.proc
1466        if p is None:
1467            return False
1468        try:
1469            parent = psutil.Process(p.pid)
1470            procs = parent.children(recursive=True) + [parent]
1471        except psutil.Error:
1472            return False
1473        for q in procs:
1474            try:
1475                q.terminate()
1476            except psutil.Error:
1477                pass
1478        _, alive = psutil.wait_procs(procs, timeout=2)
1479        for q in alive:
1480            try:
1481                q.kill()
1482            except psutil.Error:
1483                pass
1484        return bool(alive)
1485
1486    def stop_test(self, result, summary=True):
1487        if not self.running:
1488            return
1489        self.running = False
1490        forced = self._kill_tree()
1491        if forced:
1492            result += " (force-stopped)"
1493        self.proc = None
1494        if self.poller:
1495            self.poller.stop()
1496        duration = time.monotonic() - self.t_start
1497        self.btn_start.config(state="normal")
1498        self.btn_stop.config(state="disabled")
1499        self._sync_controls()
1500        self._show_target()
1501        self._drain_events()
1502        if self.replay:
1503            self.replay = None
1504            self._set_status(f"Replay ended: {result}", REPLAY_COLOR)
1505        elif summary:
1506            self._show_summary(result, duration)
1507            self._set_status(f"Test ended: {result}")
1508        self._clear_readout()
1509
1510    def _fail(self, msg):
1511        """UC-13: nothing is shown as running, no telemetry left on screen."""
1512        messagebox.showerror("Can't start test", msg)
1513        self._set_status(msg, "#f87171")
1514
1515    def _on_close(self):
1516        if self.idle:
1517            self.idle.stop()
1518            self.idle = None
1519        if self.control:
1520            self.control.close()
1521            self.control = None
1522        if self.link:
1523            control.unpublish_link()
1524            self.link.close()
1525            self.link = None
1526        self.stop_test("closed", summary=False)
1527        self.root.destroy()
1528
1529    # ------------------------------------------------------------ per-frame loop
1530    def tick(self):
1531        now = time.monotonic()
1532        raw_dt = now - self.last_tick
1533        dt = min(0.1, raw_dt)
1534        self.last_tick = now
1535        if raw_dt > 0:
1536            self.fps += (1.0 / raw_dt - self.fps) * 0.05
1537        try:
1538            if self.link:
1539                self._drain_link()
1540            if self.control:
1541                self._drain_control()
1542            self._idle_sync()
1543            if self.running:
1544                self._tick_running(now)
1545            elif self.idle:
1546                self._tick_idle(now)
1547            self._animate(dt)
1548            if self.running and self.replay:
1549                self.clock.config(text=f"▶ REPLAY (recorded)  {now - self.t_start:4.1f}s", fg=REPLAY_COLOR)
1550            elif self.running:
1551                blink = int((now - self.t_start) * 2) % 2 == 0
1552                while self.sample_times and now - self.sample_times[0] > 1.0:
1553                    self.sample_times.popleft()
1554                # FR-12 / NFR-1 shown live: drawing rate and sensor samples per second
1555                self.clock.config(text=f"{'●' if blink else '○'} LIVE  {now - self.t_start:5.1f}s   "
1556                                       f"{self.fps:3.0f} FPS · {len(self.sample_times):2d} Hz", fg="#ff3b3b")
1557            else:
1558                self.clock.config(text="IDLE · LIVE READINGS" if self.idle_sample else "IDLE", fg=MUTED)
1559        except Exception as e:  # never let the loop die (FR-17)
1560            self._set_status(f"Internal error: {e}", "#f87171")
1561        # aim at the next 1/60 s boundary (a fixed 16 ms wait drifts below 60 FPS on Windows)
1562        self.root.after(max(1, int(1000 * (1 / 60 - (time.monotonic() - now)))), self.tick)
1563
1564    def _wl_fresh(self, now):
1565        return self.wl_got_data and now - self.wl_time <= STALE_S
1566
1567    def _tick_running(self, now):
1568        elapsed = now - self.t_start
1569        if self.replay:
1570            self._tick_replay(elapsed)
1571            return
1572        p = self.proc
1573        self._drain_events()
1574        if self.is_ai and elapsed >= self.duration:
1575            self.stop_test("time limit reached")  # UC-7 alt b
1576            return
1577        if self.is_code and elapsed >= self.duration + 5:  # the runner stops it at the limit itself
1578            self.stop_test("time limit reached")
1579            return
1580        if p.poll() is not None:
1581            # process ended on its own: failure to start (UC-13) or completion (UC-9)
1582            time.sleep(0.05)  # let the reader thread drain the last lines
1583            self._drain_events()
1584            label = TESTS[self.test_key]["label"]
1585            if self.is_ai:
1586                if self.wl_error and not self.ai_steps:
1587                    self.stop_test("failed", summary=False)
1588                    self._fail(f"{label} failed to start: {self.wl_error}")
1589                elif self.wl_error:
1590                    self.stop_test(f"failed — {self.wl_error}")
1591                elif self.ai_done_text is None:
1592                    self.stop_test("time limit reached" if elapsed >= self.duration - 2 else
1593                                   f"agent stopped without finishing ({self.ai_stop_text or 'no reason given'})")
1594                else:
1595                    self.stop_test("completed")
1596            elif not self.wl_got_data:
1597                err = self.wl_error or f"workload exited with code {p.returncode}"
1598                self.stop_test("failed", summary=False)
1599                self._fail(f"{label} failed to start: {err}")
1600            elif self.wl_error:
1601                self.stop_test(f"failed — {self.wl_error}")
1602            elif self.is_code:
1603                self.stop_test(self.code_exit or "program ended")
1604            else:
1605                self.stop_test("completed")
1606            return
1607
1608        if self.is_code:
1609            self._set_status(f"Running your program — {elapsed:.0f} s (stops at {self.duration:.0f} s)")
1610        else:
1611            self._set_status(f"Running {TESTS[self.test_key]['label']} on "
1612                             f"{PARTS[self.target]['label']} — {elapsed:.0f}/{self.duration:.0f} s")
1613
1614        s = self.poller.latest
1615        if not s or s["t"] == self.last_t:
1616            return
1617        self.last_t = s["t"]
1618        self.sample_times.append(now)
1619
1620        merged = dict(s)
1621        fresh = self._wl_fresh(now)
1622        if fresh:
1623            merged.update(self.wl)
1624            if "gbps" in self.wl:
1625                self.peak_gbps = max(self.peak_gbps, self.wl["gbps"])
1626        row = {"t": round(elapsed, 3)}
1627        for k, v in merged.items():
1628            if v is not None and k != "t":
1629                if isinstance(v, (int, float)):
1630                    self.samples.setdefault(k, []).append(v)
1631                row[k] = round(v, 4) if isinstance(v, float) else v
1632        self.record.append(row)
1633
1634        self._update_readout(merged, fresh)
1635        self._check_thermal(merged)
1636
1637    def _tick_replay(self, elapsed):
1638        """One frame of a replay: show the recorded sample for this moment. Nothing is measured,
1639        recorded or safety-checked - the clock and status line say it is a recording."""
1640        run = self.replay
1641        if elapsed >= self.duration + 0.3:
1642            self.stop_test("finished")
1643            return
1644        self._set_status(f"REPLAY (recorded {run.get('when', '?')}, not live) — "
1645                         f"{run.get('test_label', '?')} on {PARTS[self.target]['label']} — "
1646                         f"{min(elapsed, self.duration):.0f}/{self.duration:.0f} s", REPLAY_COLOR)
1647        s = self.poller.latest
1648        if s["t"] == self.last_t:
1649            return
1650        self.last_t = s["t"]
1651        self.sample_times.append(time.monotonic())
1652        self.wl = {k: s[k] for k in WL_KEYS if k in s}
1653        self.peak_gbps = max(self.peak_gbps, s.get("gbps") or 0.0)
1654        self._update_readout(s, True)
1655
1656    def _src(self, key, default):
1657        """Where a metric comes from on the current target (the poller may name another source)."""
1658        p = self.poller if self.running else self.idle
1659        src = (getattr(p, "sources", None) or {}).get(key, default)
1660        if key in ("cpu_temp", "board_temp") and telemetry.LHM and src == default:
1661            src = "LibreHardwareMonitor"
1662        link = (getattr(p, "info", None) or {}).get("pcie_link")
1663        if key == "board_util" and link and src == default:
1664            src = f"{src} · {link}"
1665        return src
1666
1667    def _update_readout(self, m, wl_fresh):
1668        unavail = set()
1669        for key, label, unit, part, src in STATS:
1670            src = self._src(key, src)
1671            v = m.get(key)
1672            relevant = part == "wl" or part in self.involved
1673            if not relevant:
1674                self.stat_val[key].config(text="—", fg=MUTED)
1675                self._set_src(key, src, MUTED)
1676            elif v is None and part == "wl":
1677                self.stat_val[key].config(text="—", fg=MUTED)
1678                self._set_src(key, "not in this test", MUTED)
1679            elif v is None:
1680                self.stat_val[key].config(text="unavailable", fg="#f87171")
1681                self._show_missing(key, src)
1682                if part in PARTS:
1683                    unavail.add(key)
1684            else:
1685                self.stat_val[key].config(text=f"{FMT.get(key, '{:.2f}').format(v)} {unit}", fg=FG)
1686                self._set_src(key, src, MUTED)
1687        # UC-12: if every metric of the target part fails for a second, the run can't be shown
1688        # truthfully (a second, because some readings need a moment to produce their first value)
1689        target_keys = [k for k, _, _, pt, _ in STATS if pt == self.target and k not in OPTIONAL]
1690        if not self.replay and target_keys and all(m.get(k) is None for k in target_keys):
1691            now = time.monotonic()
1692            self.lost_since = self.lost_since or now
1693            if now - self.lost_since >= 1.0:
1694                self.stop_test(f"stopped — {PARTS[self.target]['label']} telemetry lost")
1695                return
1696        else:
1697            self.lost_since = None
1698        self.msg_unavail = unavail
1699
1700    def _check_thermal(self, m):
1701        checks = [("cpu", m.get("cpu_temp"), THERMAL_LIMIT["cpu"]),
1702                  ("gpu", m.get("gpu_temp"), min(THERMAL_LIMIT["gpu"], m.get("gpu_slowdown") or 999))]
1703        for part, temp, limit in checks:
1704            if part in self.involved and temp is not None and temp >= limit:
1705                name = PARTS[part]["label"]
1706                self.stop_test(f"aborted — thermal limit ({name} {temp:.0f} °C)")
1707                messagebox.showwarning("Thermal limit",
1708                                       f"{name} reached {temp:.0f} °C (limit {limit:.0f} °C). Test stopped.")
1709                return
1710
1711    def _target_levels(self):
1712        """Latest real utilization 0..1 per part (None = unavailable)."""
1713        idle = not self.running and self.idle_sample is not None
1714        s = self.idle_sample if idle else (self.poller.latest if self.poller else {})
1715        out = {}
1716        for part in ORDER:
1717            if idle:  # live readings while no test runs: every part, as it is
1718                v = s.get(f"{part}_util")
1719                out[part] = 0.0 if v is None else v / 100.0
1720                continue
1721            if not self.running or part not in self.involved:
1722                out[part] = 0.0
1723                continue
1724            if part == "ram" and self.script == "ram" and self.peak_gbps > 0 and "gbps" in self.wl:
1725                out[part] = min(1.0, self.wl["gbps"] / self.peak_gbps)
1726                continue
1727            v = s.get(f"{part}_util")
1728            if part == "disk" and v is None and s.get("disk_read") is not None:
1729                # no active-time counter: fall back to throughput relative to this run's peak
1730                mb = s["disk_read"] + (s.get("disk_write") or 0.0)
1731                self.peak_io = max(self.peak_io, mb, 200.0)
1732                v = 100.0 * mb / self.peak_io
1733            out[part] = None if v is None else v / 100.0
1734        return out
1735
1736    def _animate(self, dt):
1737        targets = self._target_levels()
1738        self.frame_n += 1
1739        for key in ORDER:
1740            tgt = targets[key]
1741            if tgt is None:  # unavailable: stops animating
1742                tgt = 0.0
1743            # ease toward the latest real sample (never overshoots it)
1744            self.level[key] += (tgt - self.level[key]) * min(1.0, dt * 12)
1745            lv = self.level[key]
1746            if not self.options[key]:
1747                continue
1748            base = PARTS[key]["color"]
1749            rect, text, sub = self.shapes[key]
1750            # panel body warms with load; edge goes white when this part is selected
1751            self.canvas.itemconfig(rect, fill=mix(PANEL, base, lv * 0.22))
1752            edge = mix(mix(base, BG, 0.5), base, lv)
1753            self.canvas.itemconfig(rect, outline=lighten(base, 0.7) if key == self.selected else edge)
1754            outer_halo, inner_halo = self.glows[key]
1755            glow_on = lv > 0.03
1756            self.canvas.itemconfig(outer_halo, outline=mix(BG, base, lv * 0.30) if glow_on else BG)
1757            self.canvas.itemconfig(inner_halo, outline=mix(BG, base, lv * 0.65) if glow_on else BG)
1758            # segmented meter
1759            lit = round(lv * SEGMENTS)
1760            if lit != self._lit.get(key):
1761                self._lit[key] = lit
1762                for i, seg in enumerate(self.bars[key]):
1763                    c = (mix(mix(base, BG, 0.3), lighten(base, 0.4), i / SEGMENTS)) if i < lit else "#1a1a1a"
1764                    self.canvas.itemconfig(seg, fill=c)
1765            show = self.running and key in self.involved
1766            if not self.running and self.idle_sample is not None and self.idle_sample.get(f"{key}_util") is not None:
1767                # idle: the live value, quieter than during a test
1768                self.canvas.itemconfig(sub, text=f"{lv * 100:.0f}%", fill=mix(base, BG, 0.35), font=(FONT, 26, "bold"))
1769            elif show and targets[key] is not None:
1770                self.canvas.itemconfig(sub, text=f"{lv * 100:.0f}%", fill=lighten(base, 0.5), font=(FONT, 36, "bold"))
1771            elif show:
1772                self.canvas.itemconfig(sub, text="UNAVAILABLE", fill="#ff5c5c", font=(FONT, 13, "bold"))
1773            else:
1774                self.canvas.itemconfig(sub, text="")
1775            # history graph: one point per 3 frames, scrolls left; bounded by the eased real samples
1776            hist = self.history[key]
1777            if self.frame_n % 3 == 0:
1778                hist.append(lv)
1779                gx0, gx1, gy0, gy1 = self.graph_box[key]
1780                step = (gx1 - gx0) / (HISTORY - 1)
1781                pts = []
1782                for i, v in enumerate(hist):
1783                    pts += [gx0 + i * step, gy1 - (gy1 - gy0) * v]
1784                self.canvas.coords(self.graphs[key], *pts)
1785                self.canvas.itemconfig(self.graphs[key], fill=mix(mix(base, BG, 0.5), base, 0.4 + 0.6 * lv))
1786        # per-core strip: eased toward each core's latest real reading
1787        cores = None
1788        if self.running and "cpu" in self.involved and self.poller:
1789            c = (self.poller.latest or {}).get("cpu_cores")
1790            cores = c if isinstance(c, list) and c else None
1791        elif not self.running and self.idle_sample:
1792            c = self.idle_sample.get("cpu_cores")
1793            cores = c if isinstance(c, list) and c else None
1794        n = len(self.core_bars)
1795        lit = lighten(PARTS["cpu"]["color"], 0.3)
1796        for i in range(n):
1797            if cores:
1798                a, b = i * len(cores) // n, (i + 1) * len(cores) // n
1799                tgt = max(cores[a:b] or [cores[min(a, len(cores) - 1)]]) / 100.0
1800            else:
1801                tgt = 0.0
1802            self.core_lv[i] += (tgt - self.core_lv[i]) * min(1.0, dt * 12)
1803            top, bot = self.core_box
1804            h = round((bot - top) * self.core_lv[i])
1805            if h != self._core_col.get(i):  # bar height = that core's load
1806                self._core_col[i] = h
1807                xa, _, xb, _ = self.canvas.coords(self.core_bars[i])
1808                self.canvas.coords(self.core_bars[i], xa, bot - h, xb, bot)
1809                self.canvas.itemconfig(self.core_bars[i], fill=mix(PARTS["cpu"]["color"], lit, self.core_lv[i]))
1810        for (a, b), item in self.links.items():
1811            flow = (self.level[a] + self.level[b]) / 2
1812            if (self.running or self.idle_sample is not None) and flow > 0.02:
1813                self.dash_off[(a, b)] -= dt * ((20 + 160 * flow) if self.running else (10 + 60 * flow))
1814                trace = mix(PARTS[a]["color"], PARTS[b]["color"], 0.5)
1815                self.canvas.itemconfig(item, dashoffset=int(self.dash_off[(a, b)]),
1816                                       fill=mix(GREY, lighten(trace, 0.3), flow))
1817            else:
1818                self.canvas.itemconfig(item, fill=GREY)
1819

1821    def _clear_readout(self):
1822        for key, _, _, _, src in STATS:
1823            if key in ("cpu_temp", "board_temp") and telemetry.LHM:
1824                src = "LibreHardwareMonitor"  # running: the readings come from it during a test
