1828    # ------------------------------------------------------------ live readings while idle
1829    def _idle_sync(self):
1830        """Keeps a slow poller running while no test runs on this PC, so the readings and the
1831        diagram are live; remade when the chosen GPU / disk changes or LHM appears."""
1832        want = not self.running
1833        key = (self.gpu_index, self.disk_index, telemetry.LHM)
1834        if self.idle and (not want or key != self.idle_key):
1835            self.idle.stop()
1836            self.idle, self.idle_sample = None, None
1837            if not want:
1838                self._clear_readout()
1839        if want and not self.idle:
1840            gpus, disks = self.hw.get("gpu_info") or [], self.hw.get("disks") or []
1841            gpu = gpus[self.gpu_index] if gpus and self.gpu_index < len(gpus) else None
1842            disk = disks[self.disk_index] if disks and self.disk_index < len(disks) else None
1843            try:
1844                self.idle = telemetry.Poller(gpu, disk, hz=4)
1845                self.idle.start()
1846                self.idle_key = key
1847            except Exception as e:  # never stop the app over the extra readings
1848                self.idle = None
1849                self._log(f"Live readings unavailable: {e}", "info")
1850
1851    def _tick_idle(self, now):
1852        s = self.idle.latest
1853        if s and s is not self.idle_sample:
1854            self.idle_sample = s
1855            for key, label, unit, part, src in STATS:
1856                src = self._src(key, src)
1857                v = s.get(key)
1858                if part == "wl":
1859                    self.stat_val[key].config(text="—", fg=MUTED)
1860                    self._set_src(key, "shown during its test", MUTED)
1861                elif v is None:
1862                    self.stat_val[key].config(text="—", fg=MUTED)
1863                    self._show_missing(key, src)
1864                else:
1865                    self.stat_val[key].config(text=f"{FMT.get(key, '{:.2f}').format(v)} {unit}", fg=MUTED)
1866                    self._set_src(key, src, MUTED)
1867        if self._lhm_found:
1868            self._lhm_found = False
1869            self._log("LibreHardwareMonitor found: CPU and chipset temperatures are readable now.", "done")
1870        # after "SET UP" for LibreHardwareMonitor: look for it now and then
1871        if now < self._lhm_watch and now >= self._lhm_next:
1872            self._lhm_next = now + 5
1873            threading.Thread(target=self._probe_lhm_bg, daemon=True).start()
1874
1875    def _probe_lhm_bg(self):
1876        """Runs on a thread: only sets flags (Tk may only be touched from the UI thread)."""
1877        if telemetry.probe_lhm():
1878            self._lhm_watch = 0.0
1879            self.hw["cpu_temp"] = True
1880            self._lhm_found = True

1882    # ------------------------------------------------------------ why a reading is missing, and the fix
1883    def _set_src(self, key, text, color, fix=None):
1884        self.stat_fix[key] = fix
1885        self.stat_src[key].config(text=text, fg=color, cursor="hand2" if fix else "")
1886
1887    def _why_missing(self, key, src):
1888        """(reason, fix or None) for a reading that has no value."""
1889        nvml_ok = telemetry.nvgpu.OK
1890        gpus = self.hw.get("gpu_info") or []
1891        has_nv = any(g.get("kind") == "nvml" for g in gpus)
1892        names = " ".join(str(g.get("name", "")) for g in gpus).lower()
1893        if key in ("cpu_temp", "board_temp"):
1894            if not telemetry.LHM:
1895                return ("needs LibreHardwareMonitor · SET UP ›", "lhm")
1896            return ("board has no named sensor" if key == "board_temp" else "LHM has no reading", None)
1897        if key in ("board_util", "pcie_rx", "pcie_tx"):
1898            if not nvml_ok and "nvidia" in names:
1899                return ("needs the nvidia-ml-py package · INSTALL ›", "pip:nvidia-ml-py")
1900            if not has_nv:
1901                return ("needs an NVIDIA graphics card (NVML)", None)
1902        if key.startswith("gpu_"):
1903            if not gpus:
1904                return ("no graphics card found", None)
1905            if not nvml_ok and "nvidia" in names:
1906                return ("needs the nvidia-ml-py package · INSTALL ›", "pip:nvidia-ml-py")
1907            if not has_nv and key in ("gpu_temp", "gpu_power") and not telemetry.LHM:
1908                return ("needs LibreHardwareMonitor for this GPU · SET UP ›", "lhm")
1909        if key == "cpu_power":
1910            return ("Windows doesn't report it for this processor", None)
1911        if key == "disk_util":
1912            return ("Windows' disk counter isn't available", None)
1913        if key == "cpu_freq":
1914            return ("not reported on this PC", None)
1915        return (src, None)
1916
1917    def _show_missing(self, key, src):
1918        reason, fix = self._why_missing(key, src)
1919        self._set_src(key, reason, "#f0b429" if fix else "#f87171", fix)
1920
1921    def _run_fix(self, fix):
1922        if not fix:
1923            return
1924        if fix == "lhm":
1925            script = os.path.join(HERE, "setup_lhm.ps1")
1926            if not messagebox.askokcancel(
1927                    "Set up LibreHardwareMonitor",
1928                    "Windows only gives out CPU and chipset temperatures (and AMD / Intel GPU temperatures) through "
1929                    "LibreHardwareMonitor running as administrator.\n\nThis downloads LibreHardwareMonitor 0.9.6 "
1930                    "(checked against its known hash), starts it hidden in the tray at every logon and keeps its "
1931                    "port closed to other machines. Windows asks once for admin rights.\n\nGo ahead?"):
1932                return
1933            try:
1934                subprocess.Popen(["powershell", "-ExecutionPolicy", "Bypass", "-File", script],
1935                                 creationflags=getattr(subprocess, "CREATE_NEW_CONSOLE", 0))
1936            except OSError as e:
1937                messagebox.showerror("Set up LibreHardwareMonitor", f"Couldn't start the setup: {e}")
1938                return
1939            self._lhm_watch = time.monotonic() + 180  # look for it for 3 minutes
1940            self._log("Setting up LibreHardwareMonitor in a separate window - the temperatures appear here "
1941                      "once it runs.", "info")
1942        elif fix.startswith("pip:"):
1943            pkg = fix[4:]
1944            if not messagebox.askokcancel("Install " + pkg, f"Install the Python package {pkg} into this Python "
1945                                          f"({sys.executable})?\n\nRestart the app when it has finished."):
1946                return
1947            try:
1948                subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, "-m", "pip", "install", pkg],
1949                                 creationflags=getattr(subprocess, "CREATE_NEW_CONSOLE", 0))
1950            except OSError as e:
1951                messagebox.showerror("Install " + pkg, f"Couldn't start pip: {e}")
1952                return
1953            self._log(f"Installing {pkg} in a separate window - restart the app when it's done.", "info")
1954

1960    def _test_tip(self, key):

1962        parts = ", ".join(PARTS[p]["label"] for p in t["targets"]) if len(t["targets"]) < len(ORDER) else "any part"
1963        what = {"2d": "Draws Mandelbrot frames on every CPU core, or copies big blocks of memory (RAM).",
1964                "3d": "Renders a 3D scene with OpenGL and measures the frame time.",
1965                "ml": "Trains a small neural network with PyTorch.",
1966                "io": "Writes then reads a 1 GB temporary file, bypassing the cache.",

1968                "ai": "A local AI model (Ollama) decides what code to run, in a sandbox.",
1969                "code": "Your own program: pick the file that starts it."}.get(key, "")
1970        tip = f"{t['label']}: {what}\nWorks on: {parts}."

1975    def _update_steps(self):
1976        running = getattr(self, "running", False)
1977        part = PARTS[self.selected]["label"] if self.selected else None
1978        test = TESTS[self.test_var.get()]["short"]
1979        need_prog = self.test_var.get() == "code" and not self.program_var.get().strip()
1980        texts = [f"① PART: {part} ✓" if part else "① CLICK A PART",
1981                 f"② TEST: {test}" + (" - pick your program below" if need_prog else (" ✓" if part else "")),
1982                 "③ RUNNING…" if running else "③ PRESS START"]
1983        states = [bool(part), bool(part) and not need_prog, running]
1984        nxt = next((i for i, done in enumerate(states) if not done), None)
1985        for i, lab in enumerate(self.step_labels):
1986            lab.config(text=texts[i], fg=STEP_DONE if states[i] else (STEP_NEXT if i == nxt else STEP_TODO))

1988    # ------------------------------------------------------------ YOUR CODE: folder, Python, recent programs
1989    def _code_plan(self, command):
1990        """(python, folder, note): how YOUR CODE will run. A .py file runs with the project's venv
1991        (.venv / venv / env next to it or in the project's top folder) or this Python, in the FOLDER
1992        field or the project's top folder (.git, requirements.txt... - like VS Code's Run)."""
1993        import profiler
1994        m = re.match(r'\s*(?:"([^"]+)"|(\S+))(.*)$', command or "")
1995        first = (m.group(1) or m.group(2)) if m else ""
1996        folder = self.folder_var.get().strip().strip('"')
1997        python = None
1998        script = first if first.lower().endswith((".py", ".pyw")) and os.path.isfile(first) else None
1999        if not script and os.path.isfile(first) and m:  # "python.exe" "script.py" ...
2000            m2 = re.match(r'\s*(?:"([^"]+)"|(\S+))', m.group(3))
2001            second = (m2.group(1) or m2.group(2)) if m2 else ""
2002            if second.lower().endswith(".py") and os.path.isfile(second):
2003                folder = folder or profiler.project_root(second)
2004        if script:
2005            root = profiler.project_root(script)
2006            folder = folder or root
2007            for base in dict.fromkeys([os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(script)), root, folder]):
2008                for name in (".venv", "venv", "env"):
2009                    exe = os.path.join(base, name, "Scripts" if os.name == "nt" else "bin",
2010                                       "python.exe" if os.name == "nt" else "python")
2011                    if os.path.isfile(os.path.join(base, name, "pyvenv.cfg")) and os.path.isfile(exe):
2012                        python = exe
2013                        break
2014                if python:
2015                    break
2016        if folder and not os.path.isdir(folder):
2017            return python, None, f"Folder not found: {folder}"
2018        def short(path, n=48):
2019            return path if len(path) <= n else "…" + path[-(n - 1):]
2020        if script:
2021            if python:
2022                rel = os.path.relpath(python, folder) if folder else python
2023                py_text = f"the project's venv ({rel if not rel.startswith('..') else short(python)})"
2024            else:
2025                py_text = f"this Python ({short(sys.executable, 40)})"
2026            note = f"Runs with {py_text}  ·  in {short(folder)}"
2027        elif command:
2028            where = folder or (os.path.dirname(first) if os.path.isfile(first) else "your home folder")
2029            note = f"Runs as typed  ·  in {short(where)}"
2030        else:
2031            note = ""
2032        return python, folder or None, note
2033
2034    def _show_plan(self):
2035        if self.test_var.get() != "code":

2037        cmd = self.program_var.get().strip()
2038        _, _, note = self._code_plan(cmd) if cmd else (None, None, "")
2039        self.plan_label.config(text=note or "Pick the file that starts your program (…), or type a command line.")
2040        self._update_steps()

2079    def _set_summary(self, text):

2084        links, self._code_links = getattr(self, "_code_links", []), []
2085        if links:
2086            self.summary.insert("end", "\n\nWhere in your code (click to open in VS Code):\n")
2087            for i, (file, line, label) in enumerate(links):
2088                tag = f"code{i}"
2089                self.summary.insert("end", f"  {label}\n", tag)
2090                self.summary.tag_config(tag, foreground=EDITOR_COLOR, underline=True)
2091                self.summary.tag_bind(tag, "<Button-1>", lambda e, f=file, n=line: self._open_in_editor(f, n))
2092                self.summary.tag_bind(tag, "<Enter>", lambda e: self.summary.config(cursor="hand2"))
2093                self.summary.tag_bind(tag, "<Leave>", lambda e: self.summary.config(cursor=""))
2094        self.summary.config(state="disabled")
2095
2096    def _show_summary(self, result, duration):
2097        lines = [f"Result: {result}   Test: {TESTS[self.test_key]['label']} on "
2098                 f"{PARTS[self.target]['label']}   Duration: {duration:.1f} s   Machine: {self._machine_name()}", ""]
2099        if self.is_ai:
2100            lines.insert(1, f"Agent: {self.ai_steps} tool calls, {self.ai_blocked} blocked action(s)")
2101            if self.ai_done_text:
2102                lines.insert(2, f"Agent said: {self.ai_done_text}")
2103        if self.is_code:
2104            lines.insert(1, f"Program: {self.program}")
2105        findings = analysis.analyze(self.record, self.hw.get("threads"))
2106        prev = self._previous_run()  # looked up before this run is saved
2107        prev_avg = prev["averages"] if prev else {}
2108        head = f"{'Metric':<20}{'min':>11}{'avg':>11}{'peak':>11}  {'unit':<10}"
2109        if prev:
2110            head += f"{'prev avg':>11}{'change':>9}"
2111        lines.append(head)
2112        for key, label, unit, part, _ in STATS:
2113            vals = self.samples.get(key)
2114            if part in PARTS and part not in self.involved:
2115                continue
2116            if part == "wl" and not vals:
2117                continue
2118            f = FMT.get(key, "{:.2f}").format
2119            if not vals:
2120                lines.append(f"{label:<20}{'no data':>33}")
2121                continue
2122            avg = sum(vals) / len(vals)
2123            line = f"{label:<20}{f(min(vals)):>11}{f(avg):>11}{f(max(vals)):>11}  {unit:<10}"
2124            old = prev_avg.get(key)
2125            if isinstance(old, (int, float)):
2126                line += f"{f(old):>11}"
2127                if old:
2128                    pct = 100.0 * (avg - old) / abs(old)
2129                    line += f"{pct:>+8.1f}%"
2130                    if part == "wl" and abs(pct) >= 3:  # only workload results have a "better"
2131                        line += "  better" if (pct < 0) == (key in LOWER_IS_BETTER) else "  worse"
2132            lines.append(line)
2133        if prev:
2134            lines.append(f"Compared with the previous run of this test on this part ({prev.get('when', '?')}, "
2135                         f"{prev.get('result', '?')}).")
2136        lines += [""] + analysis.report(findings)
2137        self._code_links = []
2138        saved = self._save_run(result, duration, "\n".join(lines), findings)
2139        lines.append("")
2140        lines.append(f"Recorded as runs/{saved} - REPLAY watches it again, COMPARE puts it next to another run."
2141                     if saved else "Not recorded (no samples were taken).")
2142        self._set_summary("\n".join(lines))

785    def toggle_ai_control(self):
786        if self.control:
787            self.control.close()
788            self.control = None
789            self.btn_ai.config(text="AI CONTROL: OFF", bg=BG, fg=AI_COLOR)
790            self.ai_banner.config(text="")
791            self._log("🤖 AI control is off.", "ai")
792            return
793        try:
794            self.control = control.ControlServer()
795        except OSError as e:
796            messagebox.showerror("AI control", f"Can't open 127.0.0.1:{control.PORT}: {e}")
797            return
798        self.btn_ai.config(text="AI CONTROL: ON", bg=AI_COLOR, fg="black")
799        self.ai_banner.config(text="🤖 AI CONTROL ON")
800        self._log(f"🤖 AI control is on: 127.0.0.1:{control.PORT}, token in control_token.txt. "
801                  "Everything the AI does shows here in purple.", "ai")
def start_test(self): 
1120    def start_test(self):
1121        if self.running:
1122            return
1123        if self.selected is None:
1124            self._fail("Select a component first (click a part or search for it).")
1125            return
1126        test = TESTS[self.test_var.get()]
1127        script = test["targets"].get(self.selected)
1128        if script is None:
1129            ok = ", ".join(PARTS[p]["label"] for p in test["targets"])
1130            self._fail(f"The {test['label']} can't target {PARTS[self.selected]['label']}. "
1131                       f"It works on: {ok}.")
1132            return
1133        gpus = self.hw.get("gpu_info") or []
1134        gpu_sel = self.gpu_index if gpus else None
1135        if self.selected == "board":
1136            # the board's readings are the PCIe link of an NVIDIA GPU: use the chosen GPU if it is one
1137            nv = [i for i, g in enumerate(gpus) if g["kind"] == "nvml"]
1138            if not nv:
1139                self._fail("The board's readings come from the PCIe link of an NVIDIA GPU (NVML), and this "
1140                           "machine has none - there would be nothing to show.")
1141                return
1142            gpu_sel = gpu_sel if gpu_sel in nv else nv[0]
1143        gpu = gpus[gpu_sel] if gpu_sel is not None else None
1144        if script == "mlgpu" and (not gpu or gpu["kind"] != "nvml"):
1145            self._fail("The ML test on a GPU needs an NVIDIA GPU (it trains with CUDA). "

def stop_test(self, result, summary=True): 
1486    def stop_test(self, result, summary=True):
1487        if not self.running:
1488            return
1489        self.running = False
1490        forced = self._kill_tree()
1491        if forced:
1492            result += " (force-stopped)"
1493        self.proc = None
1494        if self.poller:
1495            self.poller.stop()
1496        duration = time.monotonic() - self.t_start
1497        self.btn_start.config(state="normal")
1498        self.btn_stop.config(state="disabled")
1499        self._sync_controls()
1500        self._show_target()
1501        self._drain_events()
1502        if self.replay:
1503            self.replay = None
1504            self._set_status(f"Replay ended: {result}", REPLAY_COLOR)
1505        elif summary:
1506            self._show_summary(result, duration)
1507            self._set_status(f"Test ended: {result}")
1508        self._clear_readout()
def tick(self): 
1530    def tick(self):
1531        now = time.monotonic()
1532        raw_dt = now - self.last_tick
1533        dt = min(0.1, raw_dt)
1534        self.last_tick = now
1535        if raw_dt > 0:
1536            self.fps += (1.0 / raw_dt - self.fps) * 0.05
1537        try:
1538            if self.link:
1539                self._drain_link()
1540            if self.control:
1541                self._drain_control()
1542            self._idle_sync()
1543            if self.running:
1544                self._tick_running(now)
1545            elif self.idle:
1546                self._tick_idle(now)
1547            self._animate(dt)
1548            if self.running and self.replay:
1549                self.clock.config(text=f"▶ REPLAY (recorded)  {now - self.t_start:4.1f}s", fg=REPLAY_COLOR)
1550            elif self.running:
1551                blink = int((now - self.t_start) * 2) % 2 == 0
1552                while self.sample_times and now - self.sample_times[0] > 1.0:
1553                    self.sample_times.popleft()
1554                # FR-12 / NFR-1 shown live: drawing rate and sensor samples per second
1555                self.clock.config(text=f"{'●' if blink else '○'} LIVE  {now - self.t_start:5.1f}s   "
1556                                       f"{self.fps:3.0f} FPS · {len(self.sample_times):2d} Hz", fg="#ff3b3b")
1557            else:
1558                self.clock.config(text="IDLE · LIVE READINGS" if self.idle_sample else "IDLE", fg=MUTED)
1559        except Exception as e:  # never let the loop die (FR-17)
1560            self._set_status(f"Internal error: {e}", "#f87171")
1561        # aim at the next 1/60 s boundary (a fixed 16 ms wait drifts below 60 FPS on Windows)
1562        self.root.after(max(1, int(1000 * (1 / 60 - (time.monotonic() - now)))), self.tick)

2145class CompareWindow:
2146    """Two recorded runs side by side (SRS stretch goal): the same test on two machines,
2147    or your program before and after a change. Averages with the change, one metric
2148    over time for both runs, and what the bottleneck finder says about each."""
2149    COLORS = ("#00e5ff", "#ff9f1a")  # run A, run B
2150    GW, GH = 900, 230

2152    def __init__(self, root, a=None, b=None):

2155        try:
2156            names = sorted((n for n in os.listdir(RUNS_DIR) if n.endswith(".json")), reverse=True)
2157        except OSError:
2158            names = []

2160            try:
2161                with open(os.path.join(RUNS_DIR, n), "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
2162                    run = json.load(f)
2163                if not run.get("samples"):
2164                    continue
2165            except (OSError, ValueError):
2166                continue
2167            prog = run.get("program")
2168            what = ("program " + (prog if len(prog) <= 40 else "…" + prog[-39:]) if prog else
2169                    f"{run.get('test_label', '?')} on {str(run.get('part', '?')).upper()}")
2170            label = f"{run.get('when', '?')}   {run.get('machine', 'this PC')}   {what}   ({run.get('result', '?')})"
2171            while label in self.runs:
2172                label += " "
2173            self.runs[label] = run
2174            labels.append(label)
2175            by_file[n] = label
2176            run["_same"] = (run.get("test"), run.get("part"), run.get("program"))
2177        if len(labels) < 2:
2178            messagebox.showinfo("Compare runs", "Record at least two runs first (every finished test is recorded).")
2179            return
2180        top = self.top = tk.Toplevel(root)
2181        top.title("Compare runs")
2182        top.configure(bg=BG)
2183        top.geometry(f"{self.GW + 48}x860")

2185                                                                                     pady=(14, 4))
2186        # B = newest run; A = the newest earlier run of the same test (or program), else the one before
2187        newest = self.runs[labels[0]]["_same"]
2188        older = next((lab for lab in labels[1:] if self.runs[lab]["_same"] == newest), labels[1])
2189        pick_a, pick_b = by_file.get(a, older), by_file.get(b, labels[0])
2190        self.vars = []
2191        for i, (name, default) in enumerate((("A", pick_a), ("B", pick_b))):
2192            row = tk.Frame(top, bg=BG)
2193            row.pack(fill="x", padx=24, pady=2)
2194            tk.Label(row, text=name, bg=BG, fg=self.COLORS[i], font=(FONT, 14, "bold"), width=2).pack(side="left")
2195            var = tk.StringVar(value=default)
2196            m = tk.OptionMenu(row, var, *labels, command=lambda *_: self.refresh())
2197            m.config(bg=PANEL, fg=FG, activebackground=LINE, activeforeground=self.COLORS[i], relief="flat",
2198                     highlightthickness=1, highlightbackground=self.COLORS[i], font=("Consolas", 9),
2199                     anchor="w", width=110)
2200            m["menu"].config(bg=PANEL, fg=FG, font=("Consolas", 9))
2201            m.pack(side="left", fill="x", expand=True)
2202            self.vars.append(var)
2203        mrow = tk.Frame(top, bg=BG)
2204        mrow.pack(fill="x", padx=24, pady=(10, 2))
2205        tk.Label(mrow, text="GRAPH", bg=BG, fg=MUTED, font=(FONT, 10, "bold")).pack(side="left", padx=(0, 8))

2209                                highlightbackground=LINE, font=(FONT, 10, "bold"), width=24)
2210        self.metric_menu["menu"].config(bg=PANEL, fg=FG, font=(FONT, 10))
2211        self.metric_menu.pack(side="left")

2213                                highlightbackground=LINE)

2215        box = tk.Frame(top, bg=BG)

2218                            highlightthickness=1, highlightbackground=LINE)

2229    def _pair(self):
2230        return self.runs[self.vars[0].get()], self.runs[self.vars[1].get()]
2231
2232    @staticmethod
2233    def _series(run, key):
2234        return [(s["t"], s[key]) for s in run["samples"] if isinstance(s.get(key), (int, float))]
2235
2236    def refresh(self):
2237        a, b = self._pair()
2238        stats = [st for st in STATS if self._series(a, st[0]) or self._series(b, st[0])]
2239        labels = [st[1] for st in stats]
2240        menu = self.metric_menu["menu"]
2241        menu.delete(0, "end")
2242        for lab in labels:
2243            menu.add_command(label=lab, command=tk._setit(self.metric, lab, lambda *_: self.draw()))
2244        if self.metric.get() not in labels:
2245            prefer = [st[1] for st in stats if st[3] == "wl"] + [st[1] for st in stats if st[0].endswith("_util")]
2246            self.metric.set((prefer or labels or [""])[0])
2247        self.write_table(a, b, stats)
2248        self.draw()
2249
2250    def write_table(self, a, b, stats):
2251        t = self.text
2252        t.config(state="normal")
2253        t.delete("1.0", "end")
2254
2255        def cut(v):  # long paths: the end (file name) matters more than the start
2256            v = str(v)
2257            return v if len(v) <= 46 else "…" + v[-45:]
2258
2259        def row(label, va, vb):
2260            t.insert("end", f"{label:<22}")
2261            t.insert("end", f"{cut(va):<48}", "a")
2262            t.insert("end", f"{cut(vb):<48}\n", "b")
2263
2264        row("", "A", "B")
2265        for label, key in (("When", "when"), ("Machine", "machine"), ("Test", "test_label"), ("Part", "part_name"),
2266                           ("Program", "program"), ("Result", "result")):
2267            if a.get(key) or b.get(key):
2268                row(label, a.get(key) or "-", b.get(key) or "-")
2269        da, db = a.get("duration") or 0, b.get("duration") or 0
2270        line = f"{'Duration':<22}{da:>10.1f} s{'':36}{db:>10.1f} s"
2271        if da:
2272            line += f"   {100 * (db - da) / da:+.1f}% B vs A"
2273        t.insert("end", line + "\n\n")
2274        t.insert("end", f"{'Average':<22}{'A':>12}{'B':>12}   {'unit':<10}{'B vs A':>9}\n", "head")
2275        for key, label, unit, part, _ in stats:
2276            va, vb = (a.get("averages") or {}).get(key), (b.get("averages") or {}).get(key)
2277            f = FMT.get(key, "{:.2f}").format
2278            sa = f(va) if isinstance(va, (int, float)) else "-"
2279            sb = f(vb) if isinstance(vb, (int, float)) else "-"
2280            line = f"{label:<22}{sa:>12}{sb:>12}   {unit:<10}"
2281            if isinstance(va, (int, float)) and isinstance(vb, (int, float)) and va:
2282                pct = 100.0 * (vb - va) / abs(va)
2283                line += f"{pct:>+8.1f}%"
2284                if part == "wl" and abs(pct) >= 3:
2285                    line += "  better" if (pct < 0) == (key in LOWER_IS_BETTER) else "  worse"
2286            t.insert("end", line + "\n")
2287        for name, run, tag in (("A", a, "a"), ("B", b, "b")):
2288            findings = run.get("findings")
2289            if findings is None:  # runs recorded before the bottleneck finder existed
2290                findings = analysis.analyze(run["samples"], run.get("threads"))
2291            t.insert("end", f"\n{name}: ", tag)
2292            for i, ln in enumerate(analysis.report(findings)):
2293                t.insert("end", ("" if i == 0 else "   ") + ln + "\n", "bad" if ln.lstrip().startswith("!") else ())
2294        t.config(state="disabled")
2295
2296    def draw(self):
2297        c = self.canvas
2298        c.delete("all")
2299        stat = next((st for st in STATS if st[1] == self.metric.get()), None)
2300        if not stat:
2301            return
2302        key, label, unit = stat[0], stat[1], stat[2]
2303        series = [self._series(r, key) for r in self._pair()]
2304        if not any(series):
2305            return
2306        x0, x1, y0, y1 = 56, self.GW - 16, 18, self.GH - 28
2307        t_max = max(s[-1][0] for s in series if s) or 1.0
2308        v_max = 100.0 if unit == "%" else max(v for s in series for _, v in s) * 1.1 or 1.0
2309        for frac in (0.0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1.0):
2310            y = y1 - (y1 - y0) * frac
2311            c.create_line(x0, y, x1, y, fill="#1c1c1c", dash=(2, 4))
2312            c.create_text(x0 - 6, y, text=FMT.get(key, "{:.2f}").format(v_max * frac), anchor="e", fill=MUTED,
2313                          font=("Consolas", 8))
2314        for i in range(6):
2315            x = x0 + (x1 - x0) * i / 5
2316            c.create_text(x, y1 + 12, text=f"{t_max * i / 5:.0f} s", fill=MUTED, font=("Consolas", 8))
2317        for s, color, name in zip(series, self.COLORS, ("A", "B")):
2318            if len(s) < 2:
2319                continue
2320            step = max(1, len(s) // 800)
2321            pts = []
2322            for t_, v in s[::step]:
2323                pts += [x0 + (x1 - x0) * t_ / t_max, y1 - (y1 - y0) * min(1.0, v / v_max)]
2324            c.create_line(*pts, fill=color, width=2)
2325        c.create_text(x0 + 6, y0, text=f"{label} ({unit})" if unit else label, anchor="nw", fill=FG,
2326                      font=(FONT, 10, "bold"))
2327        c.create_text(x1 - 60, y0, text="A", anchor="ne", fill=self.COLORS[0], font=(FONT, 11, "bold"))
2328        c.create_text(x1 - 30, y0, text="B", anchor="ne", fill=self.COLORS[1], font=(FONT, 11, "bold"))

2177        if len(labels) < 2:

2180        top = self.top = tk.Toplevel(root)
2181        top.title("Compare runs")

2201            m.pack(side="left", fill="x", expand=True)
2202            self.vars.append(var)
2203        mrow = tk.Frame(top, bg=BG)
2204        mrow.pack(fill="x", padx=24, pady=(10, 2))
2205        tk.Label(mrow, text="GRAPH", bg=BG, fg=MUTED, font=(FONT, 10, "bold")).pack(side="left", padx=(0, 8))
2206        self.metric = tk.StringVar()
2207        self.metric_menu = tk.OptionMenu(mrow, self.metric, "")
2208        self.metric_menu.config(bg=PANEL, fg=FG, activebackground=LINE, relief="flat", highlightthickness=1,
2209                                highlightbackground=LINE, font=(FONT, 10, "bold"), width=24)
2210        self.metric_menu["menu"].config(bg=PANEL, fg=FG, font=(FONT, 10))
2211        self.metric_menu.pack(side="left")
2212        self.canvas = tk.Canvas(top, width=self.GW, height=self.GH, bg=PANEL, highlightthickness=1,
2213                                highlightbackground=LINE)
2214        self.canvas.pack(padx=24, pady=(6, 8))
2215        box = tk.Frame(top, bg=BG)
2216        box.pack(fill="both", expand=True, padx=24, pady=(0, 16))
2217        self.text = tk.Text(box, bg=PANEL, fg=FG, font=("Consolas", 9), relief="flat", wrap="word",
2218                            highlightthickness=1, highlightbackground=LINE)

def refresh(self): 
2236    def refresh(self):
2237        a, b = self._pair()
2238        stats = [st for st in STATS if self._series(a, st[0]) or self._series(b, st[0])]
2239        labels = [st[1] for st in stats]
2240        menu = self.metric_menu["menu"]
2241        menu.delete(0, "end")
2242        for lab in labels:
2243            menu.add_command(label=lab, command=tk._setit(self.metric, lab, lambda *_: self.draw()))
2244        if self.metric.get() not in labels:
2245            prefer = [st[1] for st in stats if st[3] == "wl"] + [st[1] for st in stats if st[0].endswith("_util")]
2246            self.metric.set((prefer or labels or [""])[0])
2247        self.write_table(a, b, stats)
2248        self.draw()
def write_table(self, a, b, stats): 
2250    def write_table(self, a, b, stats):
2251        t = self.text
2252        t.config(state="normal")
2253        t.delete("1.0", "end")
2254
2255        def cut(v):  # long paths: the end (file name) matters more than the start
2256            v = str(v)
2257            return v if len(v) <= 46 else "…" + v[-45:]
2258
2259        def row(label, va, vb):
2260            t.insert("end", f"{label:<22}")
2261            t.insert("end", f"{cut(va):<48}", "a")
2262            t.insert("end", f"{cut(vb):<48}\n", "b")
2263
2264        row("", "A", "B")
2265        for label, key in (("When", "when"), ("Machine", "machine"), ("Test", "test_label"), ("Part", "part_name"),
2266                           ("Program", "program"), ("Result", "result")):
2267            if a.get(key) or b.get(key):
2268                row(label, a.get(key) or "-", b.get(key) or "-")
2269        da, db = a.get("duration") or 0, b.get("duration") or 0
2270        line = f"{'Duration':<22}{da:>10.1f} s{'':36}{db:>10.1f} s"
2271        if da:
2272            line += f"   {100 * (db - da) / da:+.1f}% B vs A"
2273        t.insert("end", line + "\n\n")
2274        t.insert("end", f"{'Average':<22}{'A':>12}{'B':>12}   {'unit':<10}{'B vs A':>9}\n", "head")
2275        for key, label, unit, part, _ in stats:
2276            va, vb = (a.get("averages") or {}).get(key), (b.get("averages") or {}).get(key)
2277            f = FMT.get(key, "{:.2f}").format
2278            sa = f(va) if isinstance(va, (int, float)) else "-"
2279            sb = f(vb) if isinstance(vb, (int, float)) else "-"
2280            line = f"{label:<22}{sa:>12}{sb:>12}   {unit:<10}"
2281            if isinstance(va, (int, float)) and isinstance(vb, (int, float)) and va:
2282                pct = 100.0 * (vb - va) / abs(va)
2283                line += f"{pct:>+8.1f}%"
2284                if part == "wl" and abs(pct) >= 3:
2285                    line += "  better" if (pct < 0) == (key in LOWER_IS_BETTER) else "  worse"
2286            t.insert("end", line + "\n")
2287        for name, run, tag in (("A", a, "a"), ("B", b, "b")):
2288            findings = run.get("findings")
2289            if findings is None:  # runs recorded before the bottleneck finder existed
2290                findings = analysis.analyze(run["samples"], run.get("threads"))
2291            t.insert("end", f"\n{name}: ", tag)
2292            for i, ln in enumerate(analysis.report(findings)):
2293                t.insert("end", ("" if i == 0 else "   ") + ln + "\n", "bad" if ln.lstrip().startswith("!") else ())
2294        t.config(state="disabled")
def draw(self): 
2296    def draw(self):
2297        c = self.canvas
2298        c.delete("all")
2299        stat = next((st for st in STATS if st[1] == self.metric.get()), None)
2300        if not stat:
2301            return
2302        key, label, unit = stat[0], stat[1], stat[2]
2303        series = [self._series(r, key) for r in self._pair()]
2304        if not any(series):
2305            return
2306        x0, x1, y0, y1 = 56, self.GW - 16, 18, self.GH - 28
2307        t_max = max(s[-1][0] for s in series if s) or 1.0
2308        v_max = 100.0 if unit == "%" else max(v for s in series for _, v in s) * 1.1 or 1.0
2309        for frac in (0.0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1.0):
2310            y = y1 - (y1 - y0) * frac
2311            c.create_line(x0, y, x1, y, fill="#1c1c1c", dash=(2, 4))
2312            c.create_text(x0 - 6, y, text=FMT.get(key, "{:.2f}").format(v_max * frac), anchor="e", fill=MUTED,
2313                          font=("Consolas", 8))
2314        for i in range(6):
2315            x = x0 + (x1 - x0) * i / 5
2316            c.create_text(x, y1 + 12, text=f"{t_max * i / 5:.0f} s", fill=MUTED, font=("Consolas", 8))
2317        for s, color, name in zip(series, self.COLORS, ("A", "B")):
2318            if len(s) < 2:
2319                continue
2320            step = max(1, len(s) // 800)
2321            pts = []
2322            for t_, v in s[::step]:
2323                pts += [x0 + (x1 - x0) * t_ / t_max, y1 - (y1 - y0) * min(1.0, v / v_max)]
2324            c.create_line(*pts, fill=color, width=2)
2325        c.create_text(x0 + 6, y0, text=f"{label} ({unit})" if unit else label, anchor="nw", fill=FG,
2326                      font=(FONT, 10, "bold"))
2327        c.create_text(x1 - 60, y0, text="A", anchor="ne", fill=self.COLORS[0], font=(FONT, 11, "bold"))
2328        c.create_text(x1 - 30, y0, text="B", anchor="ne", fill=self.COLORS[1], font=(FONT, 11, "bold"))
